articleTitle: Music Recommendation System Based on Facial Emotion Detection Using Spotify API
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: In the world of entertainment, music holds considerable importance, especially for those who find joy in rhythmic experiences. Despite the abundance of streaming platforms that enable access to favorite songs, they often fall short in capturing the intricate emotional nuances of users. This research recognizes a spectrum of emotions, including fear, happiness, sadness, anger, and neutrality. Its goal is to enrich the user experience by developing a recommendation system that proposes songs based on the user's current emotional state. The emotion-driven recommendation engine has seamlessly integrated into Spotify, a well-known music streaming service, providing users with a smooth and individualized journey in exploring music. The system aims to simplify the user experience by eliminating the necessity for manual song searches and, instead, intuitively suggests tracks that resonate with the user's emotions. The Spotify API serves as a crucial tool for accessing curated playlists, enabling the retrieval of desired music from thoughtfully organized collections centered around specific themes or titles.

articleTitle: IcedID Malware: A Comprehensive Review of Its Techniques, Impact and Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: As the internet grows, it is more vulnerable to attacks and threats. The system might be attacked with virus, worms and malwares. There are many types of malwares on the internet today and the number keeps on increasing. One of the most threatful malware existing on the internet is IcedID malware. This IcedID malware is a sophisticated malware that is designed to steal sensitive information like personal data, bank account details and many more from the victim's system. This paper gives a comprehensive review over IcedID malware, its techniques, impact and countermeasures. The malware tricks the users using web injection which injects HTML or JavaScripts to exfiltrate the credentials of the user. The countermeasures for this malware are employee training, endpoint security, having secure email, multi-factor authentication and, constant monitoring of network and system logs.

articleTitle: Generation of Rooftop Solar Energy Potential Map Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Based Building Footprint Extraction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The project will develop a geospatial web portal for estimating roof solar panel potential. Machine learning on the basis of deep learning might retrieve footprints of buildings from high-resolution satellite images. This provides mapping area on the screen and computes energy generation using the available satellite data of solar radiation in that particular area, along with estimates about what type of panel setup is ideal. Utilizing state- of-the-art detection models (like YOLO, FCNN), the system allows for comprehensive urban planning & resource management analysis while keeping the interface easy to use.

articleTitle: Priority-Based Deep Learning Inference On Edge Devices for Military Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: This work proposes a priority scheduling formula for Quick Task Execution in a military battlefield including; image segmentation, classification, and detection which are deep learning tasks that face challenges in edge AI due to their computational requirements. Comparisons using real-world simulation scenarios show the efficiency of the proposed formula over traditional scheduling techniques by proving that it can immediately allocate higher priority tasks to resource- limited endpoints on the edge of a network. In a way, the marked approach ensures optimized task execution within queues as well as task importance matched with the computational capacity, which reduces processing time and corresponding delays, and thus improves the general efficiency. This method is scalable and reliable for risk management in military surveillance and is also suitable for any field such as disaster response and smart city planning.

articleTitle: AI-Based Learning Assistant Using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Modern education requires solutions that can handle large datasets, effectively evaluate students’ performance, and reduce teachers’ manual workload. This paper addresses these challenges by automating repetitive tasks such as question prepa- ration, grading, and summarization. It also supports students by providing self-study and progress tracking tools, encouraging independent learning. The system aims to revolutionize the educational environment for students and teachers. The system allows students to upload their learning materials in different formats (Word or PDF), create personalized questions (multiple choice, subjective, etc.), evaluate their answers, and analyze their performance using comprehensive metrics. Teachers benefit from automatic question generation, optimized assessment processes and results management.

articleTitle: Design & Simulation for 2kW EV Charger Using MATLAB SIMULINK
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: In this study, a 2kW electric vehicle (EV) charger that incorporates a full-bridge (phase-shifted) converter & an interleaved boost PF Correction circuit is designed and simulated. The suggested charger design will allow for changeable voltage and current outputs and may be adapted to many kinds of electric vehicle batteries. The charger's high efficiency, low ripple, and dependable performance are highlighted by the simulation findings, which also help to progress EV charging solutions that provides steady power with little fluctuation, and is highly reliable as a step towards reducing dependence on fossil fuels.

articleTitle: Eyeblinktotext: Empowering Communication for Paralyzed Patients Through Eye Blink Detection Using Opencv
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Numerous individuals worldwide live with physical disabilities, such as paralysis, which hinders their ability to communicate effectively. Those who have experienced accidents or trauma also face communication challenges. Paralysis, in particular, results in muscle weakness affecting the hands, feet, or voice, making it challenging for patients to carry out voluntary movements and communicate their needs. The proposed system is designed to help physically disabled individuals to translate their intentions into text by utilizing eye-blinks to interact with computing systems. Experimental results indicate an average detection accuracy of 79.44 %. Given that paralyzed individuals retain the ability to move their eyes, the natural motion of an eyeblink can be effectively used as a medium to convey information.

articleTitle: Enhanced Customer Lifetime Value Prediction at Online Shopping
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Customer lifetime value (CLV) is a critical component for businesses looking to maintain their clientele. Using a single data mining technique has its limitations when it comes to precisely calculating CLV in non-contractual situations. In order to overcome the issue, the research uses the customer lifecycle value theory to examine customer value evaluation and segmentation. The study employs Buy till you die (BTYD) models to enhance CLV predictions in non-contractual settings. These methods improve customer value segmentation and outperform traditional approaches. Through feature engineering a customer segmentation model is formed. The empirical study creates a model for customer segmentation in non-contractual contexts and segments customer value using machine learning algorithms and customer relationship management (CRM) analytical models. The usefulness and applicability of the suggested segmentation and value computation techniques are demonstrated through empirical validation, which is carried out using authentic transactional data from amazon. The customer segments were able to be explained to the recommend personalized marketing campaigns, loyalty programs, enhanced support, and other activities targeted at increasing customer satisfaction and long-term value. It is also suggested that businesses should prioritize high-value customers and find a way to uplift the moderate spenders through focused strategies, including cross-selling or bundling. This paper suggests an enhanced model tested and experimented with the performance on classifying and predicting real-time data for predicting the customer lifetime value when the customers are with infrequent buying behavior.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Skin Cancer Cases in Malwa Region: Experimental Analysis and Case Study
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The Malwa region, widely thought of as Punjab's cotton belt, consisting of the areas of Bathinda, Mansa, Muktsar, Patiala, and Sangrur, has noticed a major rise in rates of cancer. The focus of this research is to examine the available data regarding the rise in cancer incidences in Punjab's Malwa region. Muktsar has the most cancer instances out of the four districts, with Mansa, Faridkot, and Bathinda taking second and third, respectively. The examination proved that high reliance on pesticides caused for the disproportionately high rate of carcinoma in the Malwa region. The Malwa district, considered to as Punjab's ”cancer belt,” has been seeing a notable rise in cancer cases. The administration of Punjab discovered that the state has an overall prevalence of 136 cancer patients per 100,000, beyond the national average of 80 cases per 100,000. In the past decade, the Malwa region has had an enormous spike in cancer cases, which the community claims to the overproduction of pesticides degrading their groundwater resources. It is distressing to discover that over 25,000 individuals in the state have been diagnosed with cancer, and an additional 85,000 are thought to be at risk of contracting the fatal illness. According to NCRP data, the number of cancer cases is predicted to increase to more than 1,000,000 by 2020, making it an urgent health issue that requires significant and quick assistance from several organizations. We attempt to assess the Malwa region's vulnerability to skin cancer in this study. The ”Nangal Cancer Hospital & Research Institute” in Bikaner, Rajasthan, provided us with the data. About 60% of the passengers on the cancer train that runs from Bathinda to Bikaner are cancer patients, which served as the study's inspiration.

articleTitle: Implementing RDMA over Soft-RoCE with Basic eBPF Monitoring: A Cost-Effective Approach for High-Performance Data Communication
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: RDMA is a technology that enables extremely fast communication between different systems by allowing these systems to transfer data without using the CPU and operating system. This results in the rapid transfer of data and reduces latency in data transfer. RDMA, brings more efficiency in moving the data between systems, improving general performance and responsiveness in many applications as CPU is not involved in the data transfer. Traditional RDMA solutions usually require special and costly hardware, such as RoCE adapters. This can make them less accessible for companies with lesser budgets. Soft-RoCE is a software-based solution that brings RDMA capabilities to standard Ethernet hardware. In this way, we can replicate the benefits that RDMA offers without the expensive equipment, hence making it possible in environments where it would not have been feasible. Also, an innovative monitoring framework using eBPF is introduced, which offers comprehensive real-time intelligence to RDMA performance by decreasing the latency and throughput.

articleTitle: Optimizing Urban Traffic with Image Processing: A New Era of Management
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Urban traffic management is a crucial concern in today's cities due to increased vehicle density and the complexity of transport networks. Effective real-time vehicle tracking systems are critical for reducing traffic congestion, improving road safety, and optimizing traffic flow. The suggested system uses real-time video feeds from cameras strategically deployed throughout metropolitan traffic networks. YOLOv5 recognizes and localizes vehicles inside video frames, while Alex Net V3 classifies the observed vehicles as automobiles, busses, trucks, and motorcyclists. The system continuously refreshes traffic data, providing information about traffic density, flow patterns, and potential bottlenecks. This data is integrated into traffic management systems to enable adaptive signal control and dynamic route planning. This greatly increased the precision and efficiency of urban traffic management, providing a scalable solution to the mounting issues of urbanization.

articleTitle: Automation and Optimization of Manual Marks Entry with Smart Scanning App
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The application with a title “Smart Marks Mania” is an innovative solution to automate the student's marks entry in an academic institution. Traditionally, manual entry and handling of marks have been time-consuming, error-prone and inefficient. This application addresses these challenges by adding advanced technologies that include Optical Character Recognition and Convolutional Neural Network to automatically extract handwritten marks and student identification numbers(USNs) from scanned answer scripts. It offers an user-friendly interface designed to cater to the requirements of faculty and students. It offers a flexible and scalable structure for system development. Rigorous testing has been conducted to ensure the system's performance, accuracy, and reliability. Overall, this application reduces the traditional manual marks entry process by automating marks extraction, data entry and providing a centralized platform for administrator, faculties and students, thus enhancing efficiency, accuracy, and accessibility in academic assessments. This application showcase how advanced technologies can transform educational processes and enhance the efficiency of assessment methods.

articleTitle: Fake Job Post Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: By examining patterns in the text data and metadata linked to job adverts, The use of learning algorithms has grown in popularity in the detection of fraudulent job postings. For this, Research Machine emphasises the application of a number of algorithms, such as Naive Bayes and Random Forest, Together with models for deep learning, like CNN and Bidirectional LSTM, and AdaBoost. To extract useful features These techniques depend on text preparation techniques such as lemmatisation, tokenisation, and TF-IDF vectorisation. To differentiate between authentic and fraudulent posts, models are instructed in datasets and evaluated using measures such as accuracy, accuracy, memory, and F1-score. Advanced classifiers and group techniques have proven to be quite successful in enhancing detection performance while lowering false positives and negatives.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enabled Supply Chain Management with Role-Based Access Control and AES Encryption
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Blockchain-Enabled Supply Chain Management with Role-Based Access Control and AES Encryption will use blockchain technology in order to enable safe, transparent, and decentralized supply chain management. Using smart contracts deployed on Polygon Amoy Testnet, the system ensures data integrity, confidentiality, and traceability while implementing role- based access control (RBAC) in order not to give unauthorized access to data. AES encryption is set forth for secretive treatment of information, thus affording a double-layered security measure for protection against on-chain as well as off-chain transactions. The solution is intended for deployment and testing in both localhost environments for rapid prototyping and the Polygon Amoy Testnet for scalable and distributed implementation. The Polygon Amoy Testnet provides an inexpensive development environment: developers can acquire test tokens (0.807 POL) via the Polygon Faucet for complete testing purposes. Deployment and interactions of smart contracts can be checked via the Polygon Testnet Explorer. The project combines blockchain's immutability with cryptographic security to address traditional supply chain inefficiencies, enhancing trust, scalability, and data accuracy.

articleTitle: Towards Adaptive Biometric System: Updating the Enrolled Template
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Biometric authentication offers enhanced security and user convenience. However, variations in biometric sample quality and changes in biometric traits over time present significant challenges to maintaining accurate recognition. Adaptive biometric systems, which update enrolled templates to accommodate such variations, have emerged as a promising solution. This paper proposes two template update methods: one for iris recognition using a manually constructed decision rule and another for face recognition employing a lightweight neural network. The enrolled-template, which includes iris feature-vectors matching to iris photos taken under various lighting situations, is obtained using the iris technique. The face technique chooses the best feature vectors based on quality estimate, which improves recognition accuracy. Both methods demonstrate decreasing recognition error rates, emphasizing the potential of the adaptive biometric systems.

articleTitle: Secure Folder Encryption Using Homomorphic Encryption with Microsoft SEAL
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The Secure folder encryption using homomorphic encryption with Microsoft SEAL has the design and implementation of a secure folder encryption system based on Homomorphic Encryption (HE) namely the CKKS scheme. The system uses the Microsoft SEAL library to facilitate the computation on encrypted data without the need to decrypt it, thus ensuring end to end confidentiality. This is contrary to the conventional encryption methods that reveal data during computation as proposed in this paper, the system proposes a secure computation on encrypted data to address the critical security issues in the domains such as cloud computing, finance and healthcare. The implementation is made on top of efficient encryption and decryption of folder contents while maintaining data privacy, integrity and computational efficiency. Real world usability and effectiveness of the system is shown through performance evaluation across key metrics of encryption speed, decryption accuracy and resource utilization. This work also shows the trade-off between the security and the computational cost and therefore presents a viable solution for secure data processing in sensitive environments.

articleTitle: Few-Shot Learning for Multiclass Disease Detection in Azadirachta Indica
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Plant disease detection is a crucial field where numerous researchers are exploring today. Various deep learning models are employed to detect different diseases in plants. Few-shot learning is one of the emerging techniques for classification tasks from the past few years in agriculture. The study identifies various diseases of Azadirachta indica using deep learning model with a machine learning framework called few-shot learning. The dataset consists of images of leaves and trees categorized into five classes. The model uses a ResNet-50 pre-trained model as the backbone for feature extraction and adds custom classification layers for few-shot learning. This model leverages its efficiency by combining meta-learning and metric-learning approaches. This study focuses on neem leaves as they have more therapeutic value. The work shows promising results in combining meta-learning and metriclearning approaches for few-shot learning.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Regenerative Braking Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Regenerative braking systems (RBS) are critical components of advanced electric vehicle (EV) architecture and energy management systems. RBS also conserves energy because kinetic energy is converted into electrical energy when one is braking as opposed to depending on charging infrastructure to power the trams. On electric bikes (ebikes), thus, slope and linear motion affect RBS performance of a bike. Analysis for its efficiency examines obstacles like gravitational grading, air drag, rolling resistance, slip resistance, suspension, resisting brakes or acceleration resistance. Doing this enables a test of RBS functionality across these terrains as if other forces are an extension of this one. Nonlinear state variables such as State of charge (SOC) of the battery and the braking torque are employed to evaluate energy recovering efficiency. Self-regenerative braking is explored in further detail as to how it improves the vehicle mileage by methodically recycling kinetic energy into the battery to improve the vehicle's performance and alleviate stress on the mechanical braking system. In addition, energy dissipation through regenerative braking boosts sustainable automotive innovation as it helps determine the efficiency of the energy usage for operation of Electric Vehicles. As a result, RBS helps to enhance the quality of electricity usage, contribute to the further e-bike advancements, support the environmentally friendly transport, and minimize expenditure, which makes RBS a foundation for innovative Electric Mobility. Analyzing the effect is forces acting on a body at a given time at a given terrain, finding the energy regenerated in each scenario and comparing them would the objective of this research.

articleTitle: Hybrid Link Prediction Model with Explainable AI for Online Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Online social network systems are inherently complex due to the various types of connections that can form between any two nodes within a single network. These intricate structures enable users to engage in diverse interactions, resulting in constantly evolving behaviors. This results in cross dimensional evolution of complex networks with links forming between social entities with variable tie strength. This makes prediction of links in online networks quite significant for several higher tasks, like knowledge extraction, network learning, signed behavior analysis, etc. Though there exist several link prediction scores, however, the existing literature lacks hybrid link prediction score to compute the possible formation of strong or weak ties in a social network. In this paper, a hybrid prediction mechanism, namely GML-hybrid is proposed to estimate the possible links using network theory and machine learning. The proposed hybrid link prediction algorithm combines already existing distance metrics and extracts different thresholds across three different levels which comprise of first, second and third quantile used for dataset labelling. This proposed algorithm is applied on Ego Facebook dataset considering 15 classifiers for model building Further, the results obtained from 5 highest performing models are further analyzed using explainable AI using SHAP.

articleTitle: AI Guarded Code Editor: Verifying Authentic Human Input
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: AI Tools such as ChatGPT, GPT-4 and GitHub Copilot change the very nature of how developers build software by greatly helping in the quick generation of code. While this proves to be efficient for professionals, it poses challenges in the competitive programming space. Generative AI is greatly misused by candidates in coding tests and online interviews. We will design a guarded code editor that detects the probability of usage of GenAI in code submissions with specialized AI detection models that use unique metrics, such as long AI-generated keywords, unusual number of utility functions, and very verbose comments that have been shown to be associated with usual AI-generated content. We will focus on stylistic and structural markers such as redundant comments, too general or too redundant variable names, and predictable formatting to realize a lightweight and scalable detection framework that fits into a user-friendly code editor. Our system also includes mechanisms for immediate feedback that inform the users on the reasons for differences in AI-generated and human-written code, thereby promoting better integrity of code in their own practices. This solution addresses a few critical concerns identified in some recent work that detection tools have limitations to the availability of responding to a domain-specific method responsive to how it would likely be combated using misapplication of the AI system. In other words, with a code editor that does not accept the direct submission of AI-generated code, the proposed solution will most definitely prove effective in both bringing forward practicality and ethical means while ensuring originality and improvement of quality in academic and competitive programming.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact of Rainfall Variable on Arecanut Yield Production in Karnataka
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Rainfall has a significant impact on the growth and productivity of plantation crops. Although arecanut can grow in a variety of climates, rainfall has a significant effect on crop production. The aim of this study is to examine the impact of the rainfall component on arecanut yield output utilising historical yield and rainfall data from Karnataka. Over 10 years of rainfall and arecanut production data from ten different districts of Karnataka were collected and analysed to examine the actual impact. The positive correlation between yield and rainfall parameter indicated the strong dependency of yield on external parameter. The results of the study show a strong association between variation in actual rainfall rate and its impact on arecanut yield rate.

articleTitle: Swarm Robotics for Area Exploration Using Q-Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Swarm robotics is an approach inspired by natural systems, where tasks are efficiently accomplished by distributing work among multiple agents. One of the key tasks addressed in this work is area exploration. By leveraging decentralized coordination principles and a reinforcement learning technique called Q-learning, this study focuses on overcoming challenges associated with area exploration. A swarm robotics simulation is developed to map unknown environments using Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). The TurtleBot3 Burger is initialized in a simulated environment using ROS Noetic and Gazebo. The trained robots aim to collaboratively map unknown environments while efficiently a voiding o bstacles. A c ustom Q- learning algorithm is implemented for obstacle avoidance tasks. By employing GMapping, a SLAM algorithm, the robots gen- erate individual 2D maps of their surroundings and share this information without conflicts. T hese m aps a re t hen m erged as accurately as possible to create a comprehensive map of the environment. Real-time mapping by the robots is visualized in Rviz, demonstrating the potential of swarm systems. This work effectively provides a collaborative map of the environment, con- tributing to advancements in swarm intelligence for cooperative robotic systems.

articleTitle: A Study on Cybersecurity Challenges and Emerging Trends in Contemporary Technologies
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Cybersecurity is an important part of information technology because protecting digital information has become one of the most important challenges in today's world. Cybercrime in particular is on the rise, and when we talk about cybersecurity, we usually think of threats from cybercriminals. To address this issue, governments and organizations around the world are using various strategies and technologies to mitigate these risks. Despite these efforts, cybersecurity continues to be a major concern for many stakeholders.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Flood Prediction Using Linear Regression
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Flood prediction as we known is a important role in reducing the impacts of effective disasters . This paper says that a linear regression-based model is designed for forecasting flood occurrences by analyzing historical hydrological data. Dataset that includes rainfall patterns, river discharge levels, and soil moisture content, it is proposed with high accuracy. The approach predicts flood risks evaluation incorporates some metrics such as mean squared error, R- squared, and prediction accuracy to validate model effectiveness. ANN, SMV, DT, and other advanced ML methods are contrasted with each other. Experimental result reveal that while linear regression performs efficiently in terms of simplicity and interpretability, its accuracy can be enhanced by interating feature selection technologies. In the conclusion, the linear regression approach outlined in this study demonstrates substantial potential for flood prediction applications, gives awareness for early warning systems and informed disaster response planning. Keywords- Flood prediction, linear regression, hydrological modeling, Disaster management, Machine learning.

articleTitle: UNet and Dense Extreme Inception Networks: A Unified Approach to Archeological Artifact Drawing Generation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Archaeological artifact drawing is a crucial yet labor-intensive task in cultural heritage preservation and research. This paper presents a unified approach that integrates UNet and Dense Extreme Inception Network (DEIN) architectures to automate the generation of artifact drawings with high precision and efficiency. The proposed framework leverages the feature extraction capabilities of DEIN to capture multi-scale and contextual information, while UNet's encoder-decoder structure ensures accurate localization and detailed reconstruction of artifact outlines. Intermediate feature maps are processed through a series of upsampling networks, enabling the generation of multilevel edge maps, which are subsequently fused to produce a single, refined output. The effectiveness of this approach is demonstrated through large number of experiments on a Corpus of the Stampseals of the Southern Levant (CSSL) dataset of archaeological artifacts. Experimental results demonstrate that the unified architecture outperforms existing methods by effectively preserving fine details and capturing complex structures in artifact drawings. This work provides an automated and scalable solution for digitizing archaeological documentation, reducing manual effort while enhancing the accuracy of artifact representations.

articleTitle: Women Safety Alert System Using IoT with Fingerprint Authentication and Real-Time Alerts
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The primary goal of this paper is to develop a Women's Safety Alert System based on Internet of Things (IoT) which addresses safety issues women encounter in their daily life by adopting newer and more effective technologies. The system is developed with the help of IoT sensors including fingerprint module for security, GSM module for transmitting SMS and GPS module for location tracking. The fingerprint authentication feature is only triggered by a 5-second press on the sensor to avoid sending fake emergency alerts. Once the system is turned on, an emergency SMS alert is sent to the specified individuals along with the user's GPS location, thus enabling them to respond promptly and immediately. Even in the absence of conventional network, the system provides a dependable connection. With a simple and easy to use interface, the system is useful in both the urban and rural areas imparting a sense of safety and security among its users. In addition, along with incorporation of modern technologies this solution also proves to be a practical safety measure in ensuring women's safety by being more adaptable, flexible and scalable. It has a lot of potential to expand this work across other areas in order to tackle some of the challenges in society in order to make the world a safer place for women [1].

articleTitle: Unveiling Virtual World Irregularities: Machine Learning Approaches for Metaverse Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The purpose of the research venture is to employ advanced machine learning techniques to investigate the intricate dynamics of the Metaverse Anomalies to forecast risk score and level of risk. Through the use of an extensive approach that integrates the Relationship, Window, and Forecasting Algorithms, the research demonstrates the unique benefits of each algorithm. The outcomes show how well the ensemble approaches predict the future and acknowledge the value of the interpretability offered by linear regression variations, especially when paired with regularization strategies that improve reliability. Additionally, this study significantly advances the subject of anomaly identification in emerging digital environments. It illustrates how sophisticated machine learning models may be utilized to precisely and perceptively navigate the complexity of virtual ecosystems, so effectively interpreting the subtleties involved in discordant observations. The analysis, which evaluates each algorithm's performance through many iterations in model evaluation and synthesized anomaly using standard metrics like Average precision, Area under POC, F1 score, Precision, and Recall, gives a thorough understanding of which algorithm to utilize for reliable and effective anomaly detection in the Metaverse. In conclusion, this study offers a comprehensive analysis of machine learning's efficacy in detecting and predicting anomalous patterns and behaviours in the Metaverse, making it a valuable resource for both Metaverse operators and users.

articleTitle: An MPPT Charge Controller for Solar PV Installations Using the Incremental Conductance Method
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Small standalone photovoltaic systems of a few kilowatts rating consist of a solar array connected to batteries and parallel loads with a power electronic interface consisting of a DC-DC converter. The DC-DC converter aids in MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking) of the nonlinear solar array and supplies power to the load and charges the battery and is known as a “charge controller”. The solar array must be sized so that on normal irradiance, enough power is generated to charge the battery and supply the parallel load. If the DC-DC converter is a buck converter, the open-circuit voltage of the array must be more than the battery voltage. In case the converter is a boost converter, the combined battery voltage must be more than the open-circuit voltage of the solar array. If a buck-boost converter is used the polarity of the battery needs to be taken care of. If enough solar power is not being generated, the battery supplies power to the load. If the battery is completely discharged and insufficient solar power is being generated, the parallel load is disconnected from the battery, and output is zero. Operation resumes when sufficient power is being generated by the solar array. This paper is about a charge controller design, with MPPT based on the incremental conductance method. Operation is analyzed with a Buck converter.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model for Recommender System in Entertainment
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: This report revolves around a novel hybrid movie recommendation system algorithm that consists of the strengths of neural networks and matrix factorization techniques to overcome the challenges related with traditional algorithms these challenges usually include managing simple data solving the cold stack problem and ensuring adaptability to real world applications given architecture of neural network blended with materials factorization and method enables the system to provide accurate and relevant movie recommendations Movies also capture complex, nonlinear relationships, while matrix factorization helps to identify hidden features in data internal, it Effectively improves overall performance. We intensively evaluated the proposed model using the popular Kaggle data set the results revealed significant improvements in accuracy and precision compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: A Low-Cost Weight Based Automation for Warehouse Item Fetching and Billing System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The rise of ecommerce and online shopping and fast delivery requirements has led to a need for warehouses which require very quick and efficient fetching of products from its shelves. The need of making the system efficient and error proof needs the process to be automated to the largest extent possible. The use of robotics to automate warehouse operations has been the most obvious choice. The massive scale of robots makes the use of multiple robots a default choice, but it also brings about the challenges of ensuring that the bots work seamlessly to achieve the goal of automation. A number of existing solutions require a high end bot capable of image processing and mapping which make the bot expensive for use and maintenance. The paper explores the possibility of a low cost of implementation of an automated multi bot system capable of communicating among themselves to fetch the items in a warehouse using a weight based approach to categorize the automated fetching of items. The paper provides a comparative analysis of manual versus automated systems to show that the lower cost does not compromise the accuracy or the time for fetching of items.

articleTitle: Melody Mixer: Novel Music Generation by Mixing Styles with Variational Autoencoders
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: This paper introduces a hybrid algorithmic frame-work that merges Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, Genetic Algorithms (GA), Harmony Search (HS), and Cuckoo Search (CS) for detecting flaws in Computer Numerical Control (CNC) milling automatically. LSTM networks are used for processing time-series data, while GA optimizes hyperparameters to enhance accuracy. Efficient feature extraction and overall optimization search benefit from the use of HS and CS. The hybrid approach addresses challenges in real-time defect detection by surpassing individual models in metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and mean squared error (MSE). In CNC milling, this minimizes interruptions and enhances production excellence. The study aims to optimize real-time flaw detection in CNC milling by utilizing a combination of LSTM-GA and HS-CS algorithms. The project's goal is to achieve accurate and efficient defect classification by utilizing HS-CS for global search and feature selection, with minimal human involvement and production delay. The goal is to demonstrate how hybrid algorithms improve defect detection efficiency and reduce error rates, leading to precise and automated CNC milling solutions. HS and CS are used to select features and perform a global search, while LSTM is integrated into the model to analyze time-series data, and GA is employed to optimize hyperparameters. Accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and MSE are metrics utilized for evaluating performance. The hybrid LSTM-GA and HS-CS model outperformed individual approaches with 97.5% accuracy, 96.3% precision, 94.5% recall, and an F1 score of 0.954, which is equal to its MSE. This combination method is suitable for real-time industrial automation tasks as it enhances fault detection in CNC milling, reducing errors and enhancing precision.

articleTitle: Disease Detection in Finger Millet Plant Using Fine-Tuned Transfer Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Plant diseases are becoming one of the major threats to global food security, particularly in carbohydrate rich staple crops like finger millet (Eleusine coracana) which requires minimal water and can be grown in diverse climate conditions, highlighting the need for early disease detection to minimize yield losses and promote sustainable agriculture. We employed web scraping for data collection from different open source, data augmentation techniques like flip, rotation, zoom to enhance the model's performance and enhance generalization capabilities. This research focuses on developing an effective disease detection system for finger millet using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and transfer learning methodologies. We analyzed with pretrained CNN architectures, such as DenseNet121, VGG16, and VGG19, using a dataset of more than thousands of labelled images collected from diverse agricultural settings. Fine tuning these models ensures optimising model's performance and achieving better accuracy. Among the tested models, DenseNet121 achieved the highest accuracy, reaching 96.88%. Additionally, we developed a user-friendly real-time application to disease detection using Streamlit library helping the farmers to detect the disease in mobile for remote access. This study demonstrates the significant use of deep learning techniques like CNN architectures, particularly transfer learning, for developing better crop disease detection systems. By detecting the disease early and prevention at earlier stage will save tonnes of crops. This solves the major issues like food security and also malnutrition.

articleTitle: Classification of Skin Cancer via Deep Learning and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Non-melanoma skin cancer is the most common type of cancer diagnosed in humans. Although the procedure of skin carcinogenesis is unclear, a number of reports have been carried out to exceptionally explain the contrivances that lead to malignancy; (2) Methods: We reviewed the literature regarding the pathogenesis of benign skin cancer, with a focus on basal cell carcinomas, squamous cell carcinomas, and actinic keratosis; (3) Results: Several studies reported genetic and molecular alterations that result in non-melanoma skin cancer. Numerous risk factors, such as genetic and molecular alterations, immune suppression, and UV radiation, are involved in the pathogenesis of non-melanoma skin cancer. (4) Conclusion: Despite the fact that skin carcinogenesis is still unclear, several papers showed that genetic and molecular alterations are involved in this process. Furthermore, a number of risk factors for non-melanoma skin cancer are now understood, making it possible to effectively prevent the development of non-melanoma skin cancer. Our evaluation concentrated on molecular and genetic components and conducted a detailed analysis in contrast to other articles on the same subject. Non-melanoma skin cancer is caused by a number of reasons. Four performance metrics have been calculated to compare the suggested approach with the current approaches, and the findings show that the suggested approach performed better. The obtained accuracy, precision, recall, and F score rates are 95.5%, 95.4%, 95.5%, and 95.4%, respectively.

articleTitle: Design Thinking for Innovative Solutions for Math Education
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Design thinking is an iterative process and a powerful methodology that fosters innovation through human-centered approaches. This paper discusses the sequential procedure for developing a design thinking solution that was adopted. Understanding the stakeholders and empathizing with the user and their expectations is the key to forming a robust solution. Surveys were conducted, professionals in the field were interviewed and data obtained on this was analysed. Further, a Point Of View (POV) statement was formulated as a basis for our understanding of user perception. A mind map was designed to brainstorm ideas on developing a solution. A wow-how-now matrix has been used to represent the ideas in terms of the degree of innovation and difficulty of implementation. Then the ideas were ranked by polls. Based on the idea ranked highest, a web application and an AR/VR platform that helps students understand statistics and probability better was created. In order to improve the prototype, various techniques were used for testing like concept validation and split test. The reviews were taken from the end users on the working of our prototype and the feedback given was considered to improve the prototype.

articleTitle: Exploring Few-Shot Learning to Enhance NLP's Cross-Domain Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Here, few shot learning (FSL) has been identified as a valuable method for improving the flexibility of NLP when dealing with new and different datasets with small amounts of training data. Most of the traditional NLP models are affected by shift since they are based on a big data set of a different domain. To overcome this challenge, FSL facilitates training of models to extrapolate from a few examples and not necessarily from numerous samples that may be present in LMMs. In this paper, I delve into meta-learning, prompt-based learning, and transfer learning as some of the methods that can be applied to boost NLP's cross-domain performance. We explain how these methods contribute to enhance performance in the use of fewer resources and evaluate the efficiency of those techniques on textual classification, sentiment analysis, and machine translation. Also, the pretrained GPT and BERT are beneficial to few-shot learning as it takes place through contextual learning. Based on our results, the conclusion is made that the application of FSL techniques in NLP pipelines enhances generalization and reduces the time and expenses on data annotation. Yet, some of the challenges that are associated with text analytics are data bias, sensibility of the prompts and computational problems. Finally, we propose some future works for FSL such as: the proposal of a new FSL model that combines traditional supervised and unsupervised learning; the presentation of a new FSL model based on a reinforcement learning theory. Hence, with the use of FSL, NLP models can perform well in different domains of application with little to no labeled data hence transferring knowledge to different domains to increase efficiency and scale in knowledge.

articleTitle: Temporal Dynamics of Consumer Engagement in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: This paper explores into an indepth analysis of consumer behavior on an e-commerce platform, extending the study period to include November 2019 through February 2020. Looking at user interactions that come under the categories of views, carts, purchases, and removals from cart along with process discovery visualizations will help identify complex patterns of engagement, measure the impact of interface changes and quantify marketing intervention's successes. This research uses sophisticated data analytics through process mining to provide recommendations for improving the e-commerce journey through increased user satisfaction and better conversion rates.

articleTitle: Endeavour: A Migrant Worker Assistance Mobile Application with Recruit Agency Search, Emigration, Overseas Employment Help Features
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Migrant workers not only help fill the labor shortage, but they also make a substantial contribution to the economic growth. Existing research works on migrant workers assistance did not develop any mobile or web application with legal migration prediction, recruit agency, foreign mission, medical center search, emigration clearance, document attestation, remittance transfer, casting vote, and employment search features. In order to alleviate these issues, this article creates a smartphone application for migrant worker support that includes capabilities for detecting labor rights and legal migration, searching for recruit agencies, foreign missions, transferring remittances, and casting votes. This mobile application offers features for finding medical centers, finding a job, training, emigration clearance, document attestations, feedback on migration, and financial aid. Over 65 percent of the migrants provided very impactful comments regarding the planned application, according to the app's impact and potential analysis results.

articleTitle: Network Traffic Prediction using Deep Learning Models: Reducing Latency in High-Demand Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The availability of the internet and enhanced applications, more specifically, the utilization of more devices in networks, and improved computational applications has created complexity in the control of network traffic. Network traffic forecasting is an essential component in low-latency networks, as well as in real-time applications that deserve excellent service quality and efficient resource allocation. This study therefore focuses on identifying whether deep learning models can further improve the accuracy in forecasting traffic flows in a network. Therefore, with the help of LSTM networks and Convolutional Neural Networks, the work will build temporal dependencies and spatial correlations of network traffic data. There are major and minor adaptations to some classic methodologies that conform the proposed framework; moreover, it is applied to two real datasets to highlight the capacity of the model in anticipating traffic congestion with a higher level of accuracy than the traditional methodologies. Evaluation of models in dynamic network conditions is done through common parameters such as prediction accuracy, lowered latency, and scalability. Saved models show that deep learning-based solutions reduce latency at high loads much more effectively, which will help network administrators in finding efficient solutions. This study demonstrate how deep learning can aid in the prediction of traffics, and the manner in which it is changing the efficiency and effectiveness of modern-day network systems. It makes the foundation for improved understanding of traffic patterns in order to apply it to optimize future generation of communication networks.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model for Predicting Basket-Ball Player Injuries Using VGG16
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: This growing need for player safety in sports has spurred the creation of newer models for predictive analysis. The project involves predicting the injury risk of basketball players using foot images and image classification techniques. Since VGG16 is a popular Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) whose architecture has been shown to perform well in image recognition, this model is used in this study. The target is to pinpoint and categorize movements more susceptible to inducing injuries and further recommend tactical alterations in training and gameplay. The scheme achieves high accuracy for predicting potential injury risks by finetuning the VGG16 model. The project presents how deep learning can be applied in sports analytics with the objective to reduce injury instances and augment player safety. The discussed methodology predicts the incidence of injury and can be a useful resource to coach- and medial staff to help formulate prevention plans.

articleTitle: Lumbar Spine Degenerative Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: In the year 2020, the World Health Organization reported that lower back pain constituted the primary cause of disability on a global scale, impacting 619 million individuals. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) offers a comprehensive perspective of the lumbar spine, encompassing vertebrae, discs, and nerves, thereby allowing radiologists to evaluate both the presence and severity of these conditions. This paper classifies five degenerative conditions regarding the lumbar spine, which are the following: Left Neural Foraminal Narrowing, Right Neural Foraminal Narrowing, Left Subarticular Stenosis, Right Subarticular Stenosis, and Spinal Canal Stenosis. Each study from the imaging dataset is represented by severity scores categorized as either Normal/Mild, Moderate, or Severe, and every one of these five conditions are classified over the five intervertebral disc levels: L1/L2, L2/L3, L3/L4, L4/L5, and L5/S1. We will use DenseNet, a convolutional neural network architecture known for its effectiveness in feature propagation and optimization of parameters, to overcome this classification challenge.

articleTitle: The Role of Convolutional Neural Networks in Efficient Classification of Remotely Sensed Hyperspectral Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: In the remote sensing domain, significant advances have been made due to the development of several techniques for Hyperspectral imagery (HSI) classification. Achieving accurate classification of the remote sensing hyperspectral data is a huge challenge since they have complex characteristics. Several researchers have shown that the usage of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) along with several Deep learning models can be very efficient in addressing many hurdles of HSI classification like the inadequate extraction of spectral-spatial features, unannotated samples, excessive noise, the possibility of overfitting and non-linear problems of HSI. This paper provides a systematic overview of few CNN strategies that can efficiently perform accurate classification of different types of Hyperspectral images. Initially, we identify the significance and various challenges of HSI classification and how each variation of CNN combined with deep learning concepts offers good results and high-quality classification. Moreover, given the condition that in the remote sensing domain, existing samples needed for training are typically not sufficient, and deep networks need many samples for training, we discuss some approaches to alleviate classification performance. Further, we compare the performance, limitations and advantages of each CNN strategy so that we can assist future researchers to enhance the performance accuracy in case of hyperspectral image classification.

articleTitle: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Dual-Granularity Document Indexing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: This paper presents a novel framework that enhances large language models (LLMs) by integrating multigranular text segmentation with ensemble retrieval techniques. By leveraging dual chunking strategies-a broad context with larger overlapping segments and a narrow context with more precise, smaller segments-we generate complementary embedding representations that are stored in separate FAISS indices. At query time, our system retrieves semantically relevant chunks from both indices and fuses them to create a dual-layered context for the LLM, thus bridging the trade-off between recall and precision. In this paper, we provide detailed mathematical formulations, algorithmic complexity analysis, and extensive experimental results. Our framework not only demonstrates improvements in retrieval metrics but also offers new insights into context augmentation for LLMs.

articleTitle: Enhancing Question Answering Systems with Semantic Networks and NLP Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: In this paper, the following will be discussed and an analysis of how Question Answering (QA) systems has enhanced Information Retrieval using Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. However, it has been perceived that models like rule/relation based models, BERT, GPT-3 etc consider only singular context and do not have efficiency in multi-hop reasoning as well as for ambiguous queries. To overcome these difficulties, this study proposes a combined method comprising of an open-world Semantic Networks and Transformer models in NLP. The proposed system improves contextual understanding through structure entity linking and a number of hops by using knowledge graphs. These two models reveal that the proposed model has an accuracy of 0.924 which is much higher than both BERT with 0.823 and GPT-3 with 0.886. Also, the query response time is decreased to 15%, which makes the present system appropriate for use in real time. This is based on validated error analysis we are able to reduce the failure cases resulting from ambiguous queries as well as incorrect entity linking by 60 percent. In addition, an evaluation made by ten people shows better performance rating (4.9/5) in relevance, readability, and logical coherence. The results validate that incorporating transformers with Semantic Networks results in better performance of QA and thus, make it an optimal choice in safety critical fields including healthcare, finance and legal, domains of AI. The future work will include the enhancement of using GNNs and real-time entity disambiguation.

articleTitle: Gesture Control Systems in Human Prohibited Areas
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: With the use of sophisticated movement monitoring, computer vision, and artificial intelligence algorithms, gesture control systems transform interactions in environments that pose a threat to human safety. These solutions guarantee efficiency and safety while making it simpler to operate the gadget without using physical contact. They have difficulties in hazardous areas where human exposure poses concerns, such as nuclear power plants, military installations, and industrial locations. In order to improve operational safety and availability, the inquiry focuses on creating a scalable and economical solution for the dynamic environment that can be customized. This solution should provide high accuracy and sensitivity in real time.

articleTitle: Addressing Cybersecurity Challenges in 6G Networks Through AI-Driven Adaptive Defense Mechanisms and Quantum-Resilient Protocols
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The upcoming 6G networks will offer unmatched connectivity features along with virtually no latency delays while allowing fast transmissions that lead to breakthrough technologies including autonomous vehicles and smart cities and extended reality. The advancement of fifth-generation networks introduces crucial cybersecurity problems because APTs and multiple system weaknesses persist together with potential threats from quantum computers. Available security solutions must incorporate innovative methods that create resistant security infrastructure structures for current and future security threats. This study delivers both intensive evaluations of modern techniques and actual use examples then develops new integrative frameworks which link American intelligence with quantum-resistant systems. The research explores how these solutions perform in heterogeneous decentralized systems and provides practical information about deploying these solutions together with performance evaluation metrics. The research combines recent academic findings leading to secure 6G networks which solve the dual security problems of modern-day AI cyber threats and quantum vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: An Optimized Deep Learning Approach for Intrusion Detection: AE-DBN Hybrid Model with Dingo Feature Selection on CSE-CIC-IDS2018
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) enables interconnected, always-on smart devices. Attacks on network communications made possible by these interconnected devices provide a problem for cybersecurity systems. Threats to system and user operations from these types of assaults have persisted. So, one of the most popular ways to keep these vulnerabilities protected from cyberattacks is with Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS). Traditional intrusion detection systems are made more difficult by the ever-changing and multi-faceted nature of the threats that affect IoT networks. The need for more sophisticated intrusion detection systems (IDS) to detect and prevent cyber-attacks has grown in response to the sophistication of network security threats. Our paper presents a deep learning model for network attack detection that combines Autoencoder (AE) and Deep Belief Network (DBN), together with an optimised feature selection method based on the Dingo Optimiser (DO). The CSE-CIC-IDS2018 dataset, an extensive dataset for intrusion detection research, is used to test the model. In this method, DBN is used for its strong classification skills, and AE is used for efficient feature extraction and dimensionality reduction. To reduce computational complexity and improve model performance, the Dingo Optimiser is used to choose the most relevant features. The experimental results show that our strategy greatly improves the accuracy of attack detection while reducing the rates of false alarms. Accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and detection rate are all areas where our hybrid method outperforms traditional ML and DL models. This study's results show that intrusion detection systems that use a mix of deep learning classification, unsupervised feature learning, and metaheuristic optimization perform better. Cybersecurity applications can benefit from this model's potential for real-time deployment and resistance to adversarial attacks, and it offers a viable approach to enhancing network security.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Breast Cancer Using Vision Transformers (ViT)
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Breast cancer is one of the leading causes of death in women. Regular testing is of paramount importance since early detection ensures more treatment options and better prognosis rate. Biopsies, x-rays and ultrasounds are some of the diagnostic tools used to detect breast cancer. Out of these, ultrasounds being portable and ionizing radiation free provide the most feasible and harmless solution in areas which cannot accommodate expensive equipment that require rigorous safety standards to be met. Our detection system utilizes Vision Transformer (ViT) technology, i.e., transfer learning to classify tumors of the breast into malignant, benign and normal categories. Data enhancement has been done using Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE). Furthermore, we have categorized them based on BI-RADS criteria for greater accuracy and precision scores. We have chosen ViT over the more commonly used Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) since they offer a more flexible approach, capturing global relationships in images, and you can use it for larger datasets.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Brain Tumor Segmentation: Innovations, Constraints and the Path Toward Clinical Adoption
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Brain tumor segmentation is a challenging and critical task in the area of medical imaging and treatment planning. The result of the segmentation process is to generate an accurate sketch of the tumor regions by their corresponding brain tumor masks. The precise and accurate segmentation of tumors requires multiple image modalities with varying contrasts and spatial resolution. In recent years, many deep learning models such as U-Net, ResNet, VGG16, and Transformer-based architectures have emerged and achieved promising results with exceptional breakthroughs. The survey has been utilized to review stateof-the-art deep learning methods for brain tumor segmentation, clearly focusing on their approach and various strategies. Existing studies primarily use benchmark datasets like BraTS, TCIA, and Kaggle MRI datasets for training and evaluation. The survey has also discussed the variety of challenges faced in the segmentation process, including performance metrics like Dice score, sensitivity, and specificity. The study outlines a clear pathway for several future directions in the area of brain tumor segmentation.

articleTitle: Email Validator Dashboard: A Comprehensive Tool for Accurate Email Validation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Email authentication is of the utmost importance in maintaining the reliability and quality of email communication, specifically in database management and bulk email marketing. The centerpiece of the project is the development of an Email Validator Dashboard, which is a very user-friendly functionality filled with other useful parts that guarantee the accurate verification of email addresses. The dashboard really presents valuable inputs quickly in terms of deliverability, risk factors, and domain reliability due to its dynamic visualization along with real-time email validation procedures. The project's structure is such that the users get real-time data in the form of interactive charts and graphs, which make them see the transformations occurring as validation is going on, thus distinguishing it from the traditional tools. It comes with cutting-edge back-end data integrity validation processes, such as mailbox verification, domain DNS checks, and syntax verification, alongside powerful analytics. This project is really useful for organizations and developers who work with large email lists and at the same time can ensure high deliverability and compliance with data standards.

articleTitle: Comparative Study and Analysis of Prompting Techniques Using Gemini API Model and Reasoning Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) systems rely heavily on prompt engineering to enhance performance. This study evaluates various prompt techniques across different sizes of the Gemini API models (‘small’, ‘medium’, and ‘large’) using reasoning paradigms such as zero-shot, few-shot, Chain of Thought (CoT), and Tree of Thought (ToT). Metrics including accuracy, coherence, and latency were analyzed for prompts emphasizing specificity, brevity, example-driven accuracy, and creativity. Results indicate that the selection of reasoning paradigms and model sizes significantly impacts the performance, highlighting trade-offs between computational efficiency and quality. Recommendations for optimal configurations tailored to specific tasks are provided.

articleTitle: Improved Cluster-Based Data Aggregation in WSN for Efficient Data Transmission Using PEGASIS-TEEN Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are widely implemented in environmental monitoring, disaster management, and smart cities. Sensor nodes, however, have limited power resources and require energy-efficient data aggregation and transmission protocols. This project compares WSN protocols, namely LEACH, PEGASIS, HEED, and TEEN, to identify the best approach for extension of network lifetime and energy conservation. To address existing limitations, a new integrated protocol, PT-Hybrid, is proposed, combining PEGASIS's chain-based communication with TEEN's threshold-based reporting. It employs dynamic leader election, multi-hop transmission, and event-driven reporting to optimi7.e energy usage and data accuracy. The PT-Hybrid protocol and standalone protocols were implemented and tested in MATLAB using 100 sensor nodes for 100 rounds. As shown by the results, PT-Hybrid outperforms LEACH and HEED in terms of energy efficiency and closely approaches PEGASIS with balanced energy dispersal. The hybrid approach consequently achieves well-balanced extension of network lifetime and minimizes unnecessary transmissions, hence making it practical for real-world WSN applications.

articleTitle: Enhancing Awareness and Prevention of Doping in Sports: A Holistic Perspective
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Doping in competitive sports, defined as the use of prohibited substances to enhance athletic performance, remains a pressing challenge for the global sports community. Despite stringent regulations by international sports organizations, athletes often unintentionally consume banned substances through medications or supplements, leading to positive doping tests and disqualifications. This study underscores the urgent need for educating young athletes on prohibited substances and Therapeutic Use Exemptions (TUEs). We propose leveraging advanced Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology to accurately detect banned substances in food and medicines, thereby reducing accidental doping violations. The system has been evaluated using the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) dataset covering anti doping testing across 40 sports and 69 countries ensuring a comprehensive and diverse database for substance detection While direct implementation with athletes is in progress initial testing with publicly available medication labels has demonstrated promising accuracy in detecting prohibited substances. By streamlining the TUE application process, athletes with genuine medical needs can access essential medications without violating anti-doping rules, enabling them to prioritize their health without fear of inadvertent penalties. Furthermore, we introduce a dedicated online platform for athletes, featuring a community forum for professional consultations, educational resources, and peer discussions on prohibited substances. This platform emphasizes knowledge sharing, fostering awareness of doping risks while promoting a balance between athlete well-being and performance enhancement. In summary, our integrated approach combines technological innovation with community support to identify banned substances, educate athletes on TUEs, and build a collaborative network for knowledge exchange.

articleTitle: Datashield: Developing and Implementing Advanced Cloud Security Solutions
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Cloud security is an important aspect of protecting data and applications hosted in cloud environments from both external and insider threats. DataShield: Enhanced Cloud Security System, presents a robust mechanism to ensure the integrity, confidentiality, and security of sensitive data in cloud storage and transfer. The present work uses Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) to encrypt files, and the present system doesn't provide Erasure method. The proposed system is introducing a secure and efficient framework for handling sensitive data in the cloud, including advanced cryptographic techniques and a wellstructured workflow. The research work focuses on providing a secure framework i.e. Elliptical cryptography method for security in combination with Erasure method for splitting them into three fragments stored across separate cloud locations. Unique cryptographic key is issued by the system to ensure detection and flagging of changes in stored files. A unique key is generated using random key generation. With this unique key generated randomly users can upload, edit and download files in the system which is secured with the ECC technology and the Erasure method. Files encrypted and fragmented give good protection against breaches in the data and resilience to hacking attacks. This contrasts from normal IT systems, which exist in self-controlled networks. Third- party infrastructure for cloud computing has given rise to additional vulnerabilities to data. DataShield protects against these risks through distributing file storage and combining such with advanced cryptographic techniques; thus, sensitive information will never be compromised while access to the files remains open to the original users. The response time of the system is comparatively faster than the existing ones and around 30% quicker than existing systems. The throughput has improved by a similar margin, processing approximately 120 requests per seconds for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{5 0}$</tex> concurrent users.

articleTitle: Optimizing Plant Disease Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks and Docker Environment
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: In numerous nations, agriculture serves as the primary and most significant source of income generated domestically. Plant illnesses caused by bacteria, viruses, and fungi are among the many, and they can be quite expensive for agricultural companies worldwide. Crop security both in terms of quantity and quality is crucial for monitoring plant disease. Therefore, it is essential to recognize plant diseases. There are certain plant parts where the disease state is clearly visible. However, usually, the infection is seen in specific plant leaves. Many researchers use computing techniques to automatically detect plant illness using photos of their leaves. Farmers might also profit fromthese strategies by obtaining quick and suitable measures to do in both agricultural yield and quality. Furthermore, some molecular methods have been developed to reduce and even eliminate the harm posed by pathogens. Thus, this evaluationaids the researcher to identify automatically the plant illness. Also enhancing the learning and provide specific methods for disease identification in order to prevent illness.

articleTitle: Design of an Efficient Android Application Model for Managing College Events with Firebase Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The “Simple Touch” Mobile Application is a versatile tool designed to transform event management and handling of events for college student clubs. Primary goal is to streamline and simplify the management and promotion of events and also receiving real-time notification of the events, eliminating the reliance on paper-based processes. The application specifically targets event management, principles to facilitate the creation and execution of diverse events. The “Simple Touch” Mobile Application promises to redefine event management by providing a in depth, built-in, and adaptable platform that caters to the dynamic needs of various clubs and communities. The application was primarily created for Android devices; it will not provide support for other operating systems. Furthermore, even though event management and promotion solutions will be given priority, the paper might not include all capabilities that fall outside of this specified scope. However, Simple Touch seeks to provide an all-inclusive and easily navigable solution within its specified limitations to address the unique requirements of college event communities and related institutions. If there is a mobile application that notifies users or students when administrators or staff post events, everyone will receive the information at once without any forwarding, ensuring that no one is left behind.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review and Modern Approaches for Bio Signal Based BCI's
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Bio-signals play a very critical role in modern medicine, especially for paralyzed patients. The development of Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) systems, which allows direct brain-to-external device contact, is made possible by these signals, creating new ways for medical intervention and rehabilitation. Using these bio-signals, modern medicine has made great strides toward developing intelligent devices that enhance the quality of life for people who are paralyzed. These include improved mobility, supported communication devices, and environmental control. In this survey, we thoroughly assess the latest BCI-based smart devices and their medical applications.
