By finding and examining current methods, technologies, and practical uses, we seek to showcase the effectiveness and potential of brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) in providing new ways to treat paralysis. Currently, bio-signal-based control systems have been continuously used rapidly in biomedical devices and assistive robots to enhance and improve the quality of life for disabled and elderly individuals. Among these, electromyograph (EMG), electroencephalography (EEG), and electrooculography (EOG) bio-signals are highly used for improving modern technologies. The primary objectives of this paper are to detail the techniques used in Brain-computer interface-based smart devices and their applications, used in healthcare. Additionally, this paper provides an overview of applications controlled through these bio-signals and discusses the research challenges in developing these control systems.

articleTitle: Advanced Digital Twin and Machine Learning Technique for Sustainable Bridge Safety
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The need for effective monitoring and early warning systems has become a priority in the management of infrastructure due to growing concerns about the structural integrity of bridges and their recurrence. Current methodologies lack the capability to provide real-time insights into critical parameters, thereby limiting the effective implementation of preemptive measures. This project addresses this gap by integrating machine learning and digital twin technology to enhance the safety and reliability of vital infrastructure. A Decision Tree Classifier is employed to analyze real-time sensor data, including strain, load, and displacement, enabling the accurate identification of structural anomalies. Simultaneously, a digital twin model is developed to visualize the bridge's condition and guide maintenance decisions. The proposed system achieves an accuracy of 92%, precision of 92.45% and recall of 94.70% demonstrating high reliability in detecting structural anamolies. The system is calibrated using historical data and validated with the current scenario. Combining machine learning with digital twin technology, this research highlights a novel approach in reducing the risk of catastrophic bridge failures, safeguarding critical infrastructure, and protecting human life.

articleTitle: InsightScan Survey Real-Time Network Mapping and Enumeration
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The digital infrastructures are expanding exponentially. Along with the new technology, highly complex cyber threats are in the wake. What is so required now? Real time network mapping and vulnerability scan is a high priority area. InsightScan integrates the adaptive design combined with cross-platform compatibility as well as session persistence while remaining friendly to the users . This paper reviews scanning and enumeration tools such as Nmap, Nikto, Sqlmap, Eyewitness, Gobuster , Enum4linux , Dnsenum and places InsightScan as an innovative solution for cybersecurity professionals. Based on the study of Approach for Cyber Security Vulnerability Assessment Based on Open Source Tools, this paper details InsightScan features, benefits, and real-world application, making it suitable for CTF events, penetration testing, and real-time network administration [6].

articleTitle: Empowering Fake News Detection Through Innovative Hybrid Deep Learning-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The essence of getting information to the populace in the shortest time possible through social media and other interactive technologies has made it easier for fake news to thrive hence creating a menace to any society as well as its decision-making systems. This research work presents a sound AI-based approach to classify fake news using DL algorithms embedded within a CNN-BiLSTM model. Using the ISOT dataset, the comparison of the outcomes achieved by the proposed model with the original models shows that the proposed model has the highest accuracy score of 94.07%, a precision of 93.50%, a recall of 94.60%, and an F1-score of 94.00%. The proposed hybrid model architecture of CNN for spatial feature extraction and BiLSTM for capturing contextual dependencies that are essential for text analysis and have relatively high accuracy compared to conventional ML algorithms, including CNN, RNN, LSTM, and other DL methods. The proposed approach is verified by a set of comprehensive measures, including ROC curve analysis and various training-validation metrics that reveal the effectiveness of the presented approach in overcoming the challenges of fake news identification.

articleTitle: Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models for Solving DSA Problems Using QLoRA
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) for domain specific tasks is often an expensive resource intensive procedure requiring large computing and memory resources. In this paper, We introduce finetuned-leetcode-CodeLlama-7b, a version of CodeLlama that was fine tuned for solving LeetCode problems, specifically. Using QLoRA (Quantized Low Rank Adaptation) techniques, we show that smaller models achieve high performance when solving Data Structure and Algorithm (DSA) problems, providing a cost effective alternative to larger models. The proposed incremental approach reduces memory and computational needs, keeping high accuracy while providing advanced problem-solving in resource constrained environments.

articleTitle: Optimizing Travel for a Greener Future: AI-Driven Route Planning and Eco-Conscious Mobility
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Sustainable travel and transport are a pressing issue in today's world and thus the need to come up with solutions that minimize impact on the environment and at the same time optimize experiences of the end user are necessary. The research topic of this paper uses Artificial Intelligence for sustainable travel and Transportation. It can be augmented using CNN in tandem with an A* algorithm to create real-time traffic and environmental optimized routes. Emission-based heuristics and gamification also facilitate safe and sustainable travel decisions. Some features are Eco-Conqueror, which provides individualized itineraries, rewards sustainable behavior and shows one's carbon footprint and the Group Travel Hub, which allows joint planning of travel arrangements and expenses. These innovations correspond to international sustainability trends, thus providing user-friendly innovations for economic carbon footprint decrease and effective travel optimization. The Carbon Emission module rewards users with game-based points for sustainability achievements and proposed eco-friendly routes through its platform.

articleTitle: Ring-Oscillator and SRAM-Based PUF Architecture for Hardware Security
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The present research focuses on designing a Hybrid Physically Unclonable Function (PUF), which combines SRAM (based on memory) and RO-PUF (ring oscillator) technologies in order to enforce hardware security. The hybrid approach leverages the simplicity of SRAM along with the high entropy offered by RO-PUF, thereby addressing concerns of environmental susceptibility and modeling attacks. Hybrid PUFs improve randomness, increase robustness, and enable cryptographic key generation, device authentication, and secure boot processes. The modular design allows for the addition of future research in PUF technology, thus ensuring continued effectiveness in addressing new hardware security issues. Our design achieves notable results, with a uniqueness rate of 48.66% and a uniformity or randomness value of 41.77%.

articleTitle: A Unified Framework for Face Re-Identification Using Entry-Exit Cameras
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Robust re-identification of individuals across multiple cameras has become a fundamental requirement in modern security and surveillance. To address this, we propose an effective system that ensembles detection, tracking, feature extraction, and retrieval mechanisms into a unified pipeline. By leveraging lightweight models, the system minimizes computational overhead and functions effectively on surveillance cameras. The system architecture enables processing and reliable identification, making it suitable for real-time applications. Our approach involves logging entry/exit registries and matching exits with entries through a re-identification pipeline, which allows security personnel to monitor an individual's entry and exit times within a secured premise. We are also releasing an open-source test video dataset with annotations, which is helpful for evaluating the face re-identification approaches for entry-exit cameras. Our approach performed good while considering matching of exit and entry events. The registered persons were identified with much better accuracy considering entry/exit events.

articleTitle: Inspection of Ethical and Privacy Concerns in Online Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: As the prevalence of Online Social Networks (OSNs) are created, it is apparent that questions related to ethics and privacy become more ambiguous and this paper aims at giving an overview on privacy concomitants and ethical concerns surrounding OSNs, with especial attention to the susceptibility of the user data, ethical dilemmas with regard to content regulating and the impact of policies and regulations. The proposed system provides the entry to establish the enhanced, sound, and fairly protected user privacy and ethical policies for OSNs with the help of boosted privacy-related settings, decentralised identity management, the utilisation of homomorphic encryption, and federated learning. It also underlines the need to have adaptive privacy dashboards, information accessibility real-time data, and other ethical measures keeping risks like cyberbullying and unauthorized usage of data checked. The study also examines new trends which have been occasioned by artificial intelligence in content moderation and the legal development aspect of it. As much as this survey focuses on current practices and asks questions in support of proactive measures, it seeks to enlighten policy makers on the best practices to engage in and create awareness to positive handling of user data in OSNs for the safety of users, as well as promoting ethical usage of the social networking systems.

articleTitle: Optimizing Urban Waste Collection Routes: Comparative Study of Shortest Path Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Collection of waste is one of the important goals of Waste Management Unit (WMU), where collecting waste decreases the amount of time, expenses, and the impact of waste collectors on the environment. The work is to create a set of routes for waste collection that will take minimal time to get through several collection centers given the capabilities of the collection vehicles, and road systems and traffic conditions. For waste collection points, ten major stations in Bengaluru were selected along with the disposal point. For this purpose, several algorithms such as Dijkstra's Algorithm, Bellman-Ford Algorithm, Floyd-Warshall Algorithm, Johnson's Algorithm, Nearest Neighbour Algorithm, and Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) were designed and evaluated. Algorithms were measured based on parameters such as the time taken, the fuel consumed, the CO2 produced, the effectiveness of the trip that was made. The theoretical and applied objectives of the project correlate with the goals of the integration of improved optimization possibilities with operational issues with the purpose of defining such effective methods in relation to the containment of fuel consumption, the decrease in emissions and the waste management optimization in the urban environment.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of TCP Connection States Using Finite Automata
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) is a fundamental protocol in the Internet Protocol Suite, responsible for establishing reliable data transmission between devices in network communication. This study models TCP connection states using Non-Deterministic Finite Automata (NFA) and Pushdown Automata (PDA), specifically implementing the three-way hand- shake and data transfer processes through these formal methods. Each TCP state, from connection initiation to termination, is represented by corresponding automata states, demonstrating the applicability of Formal Language Automata (FLA) in illustrating TCP's state-driven structure. A side-by-side comparison of NFA and PDA, showing important distinctions in how each handles the complex flow of TCP—NFA provides the simplest solution because it is stateless. Still, the stack-based memory of PDA is better suited for the layered nature of TCP, where there are states for connection setup, data transfer, and connection teardown that can nest and recurse is provided. PDA, therefore, better meets these requirements for accurately capturing layered and memory- dependent processes of TCP communication.

articleTitle: Adoption of GenAI for Education Domain
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The rise of GenAI appears to be a turning point in the shaping of the education industry as it brings forth the ability for various civilisations throughout the globe to integrate different personalised forms of teaching and learning principles within themselves. For this purpose, the capabilities of GenAI in educational systems are demonstrated by implementing web-based application called EduFab Course Generator. As for the technologies that were applied for the development of the application, these were Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS. AI materials for creating course materials are made available by the Gemini API, along with Drizzle for the AI Course Generator database management and Clerk for secure authentication management. According to scale requirements of the course, EduFab Course Generator enables users to teach new lessons and topics which also creates the scene for GenAI powered alternative curriculum innovations. To secure the user, Clerk simplifies user management while making authentication detailed. To enrich and enhance the experience of the user at each point in time, the Gemini API develops various text formats like videos, exams, and vocational experience as learning materials for other courses. For securing the user's customized documents along with the user activity history, Drizzle supports flexible and type compliant backend database operations which enable and enhance end-user experience

articleTitle: AI-Powered Cloud Computing for Performance Optimization and Scalability in Distributed Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The IT profession has observed the ingenious application of Artificial Intelligence in the field of cloud computing as a solution to increase performance along with scalability within the distributed computing environment. Conventional cloud computing context has issues with management of resources, responsiveness, and finally security. The following paper will discuss an AI based architecture which will incorporate ML algorithms to optimize the usage of the resources available in the computer cloud to balance the load between different users and ensure security. Thus, the proposed model incorporates reinforcement learning for the dynamic load distribution, predictive analytics for workload forecasting, and deep learning based on anomaly detection to improve the security features of the system. The performance comparison with the baseline and the experiments conducted show satisfactory results in more than one performance indicators. For CPU usage, it rose to 26.4%, which was achieved alongside the provision of the 48% higher request throughput and the 40% better response time under the scenarios of the heavy workload. Moreover, the security framework using CNNs enhanced the detection accuracy of intrusion to 96.7% and a reduction of the false positives by sixty-six percent. These are some of the implications suggesting that the application of artificial intelligence can bring positive changes in the goals regarding cloud performance, resource utilization and overall security features. In this way, using AI-driven automation and prediction integrated in this work is offered a powerful, adaptive, and safe cloud model for expanded usage. With the proposed approach that has been developed the businesses and the service providers will be in a position to attain efficient business operational costs together with strong system reliability that will assist in developing the next generation of intelligent cloud computing.

articleTitle: Intelligent Malicious URL Detection Using Extreme Multi-Label Text Classification for Phishing Prevention
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Attackers employ phishing to take advantage of people's lack of awareness and knowledge about the internet. An attacker may, for instance, construct a phony website that appears to be an online store in order to obtain sensitive info such as customers' names, addresses, phone numbers, besides credit card particulars. An extension to protect internet users from phishing attempts is suggested in this research. Using deep learning models, this study specifically builds a smart warning feature for the proposed extension. By scanning for, alerting about, and blocking unsafe connections, the suggested browser extension safeguards users. In order to improve the detection accuracy and scalability, this study suggests a Malicious URL Phishing Attack Detection Model that utilizes the Extreme Multi-label Text Classification (XMTC) Algorithm. To accurately identify harmful links, the suggested method parses URLs for textual properties and then sorts them into various phishing hazard categories. Using score, metrics, the model is trained on a huge dataset that contains both authentic and phishing URLs. The results demonstrate that XMTC improves classification performance and easily handles highdimensional data, making it superior to traditional machine learning-based phishing detection methods. According to the research, the XMTC-based model is an intelligent phishing detection system that is scalable, strong, and can mitigate cyber risks in realtime online settings. The purpose of this study was to compare and contrast the effectiveness of several machine learning models by utilizing a malicious URL dataset with 651,191 data samples. The investigation's findings corroborate the suggested extension's excellent accuracy, which ranged from 96% to 97%.

articleTitle: Emotion Classification in Text Using Machine Learning and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Emotion categorization is used in domains like customer service, social media content moderation, and interaction between humans and computers. Classification of emotion from text is a fundamental issue in NLP, or natural language processing. This study examines both advanced deep learning models (LSTM networks with embedding layers) and traditional machine learning techniques (Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest) for the classification of the six primary emotions: joy, sorrow, anger, fear, love, and surprise. The study uses a preprocessed emotion-tagged text dataset, and metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score are utilized to evaluate the models. LSTMs perform better than conventional models, which find it difficult to grasp language subtleties and contextual correlations, by processing sequential data and contextual information with ease.

articleTitle: Strategical Framework Design for Prompt Engineering Analysis - ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: OpenAI's advanced conversing AI model that generates human like texts and give answers to various domain queries. It is a part of Generative Pre-trained Transformer or popularly known as GPT model and they have different versions such as GPT 3, GPT 3.5, and GPT 4. Their versions vary according to accuracy, reasoning, factual errors and more distinctively multimodality. What changes is AI's ability to understand, interpret and generate quality human like texts with each of the versions, versions which reflect the advancement. However, the ChatGPT 4 is the latest version, and it has the most robust and the most capable of the existing ones. The program's output quality is shown to increase dramatically by user prompts during the course of the research.

articleTitle: Improving Medical Imaging Diagnostics with Deep Convolutional Networks for Early Detection and Treatment
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Diagnostic imaging is an important technique which helps in diagnosing several diseases at the initial stage in order to take necessary treatments. Nevertheless, conventional techniques tend to have issues with regard to precision, speed, and quantitatively assessing multidimensional medical information. In this paper, we reveal the potential of deep convolutional networks (DCNs) in the field of medical image diagnostic. It means that, with the help of deep learning algorithms DCNs can learn meaningful features of medical images and improve diagnostic accuracy and speed. The near proposed technique involves the use of deep convolutional network model to analyse medical images for diagnosis of diseases such as cancer, heart diseases and neurological disorders. The obtained experimental results demonstrate that the presented model has the highest accuracy of 96.5% with very high sensitivity and specificity coefficients compared to other methods. Further, the interpretability of the proposed DCN model and different aspects of it are discussed to support clinical validation. Through this research, the effectiveness of deep learning in revolutionizing the diagnosis for medical imaging diagnostics while early disease detection and treatment is established.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Path Loss Prediction Model for Wireless Sensor Networks in Urban Environments
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: With the advancement in wireless sensor networks in terms of scalability, coverage and energy management, there exists a high demand for wireless channel maintenance. A channel gets affected due to many factors such as changing bandwidth, noise, loss component and many more. The conditions of a channel in real time urban Environments are dynamic in nature due to which the communication gets affected and loss in data occurs. Despite significant work done, there remains a crucial demand for more advanced models and predictions that result in higher accuracy. Among the various factors that affect the channel conditions, path loss is one crucial challenge to be addressed. This paper presents an intelligent path loss prediction model using ANN with MLPRegressor (Multilayer Perceptron Regressor). Also Machine Learning (ML) algorithms particularly KNN, Random Forest classifier, Gaussian Naive Bayes and Linear Regression are realized for comparison of results. The ANN model considers the dynamic conditions that prevail due to various factors and adapt to the real time environments. In detail performance analysis of ANN model with respect to existing four ML models is carried out with respect to prediction accuracy, Precision, Recall and F1-score. The simulation results convey that ANN with MLPRegressor model outperforms showing better accuracy, precision, Recall and F1 -Score in comparison to other four models. ANN is trained and tested with four different activation functions such as identity, relu, tanh and logistic for maximum iterations of 1000, 5000, 10000 and 20000. The results show that ANN with logistic activation function for 20000 iterations gives high training and testing accuracies. Further, the precision also reaches maximum value for ANN with logistic function in comparison with other models.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsy Detection System Using Machine Learning and Open CV
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Driver fatigue is another significant risk factor that claim a fairly good proportion of the accident rates globally. Fatigue affects the important human functions including decision making, ability to concentrate and reaction time making it of paramount importance to have good counter measures in place. That is why, the proposed Driver Drowsiness Detection System in this paper focuses on real-time video surveillance and machine learning to identify symptoms of drowsiness. The drowsiness detection of the system is made possible by integrating OpenCV and other computer vision algorithms that take pictures of the face via a camera and examine for patterns that are characteristic of drowsiness, which include yawning, blinking of the eyes frequently, or the closing of the eyes for too long. That is, the use of OpenCV in facial landmark detection and other computations such as EAR and MAR with the help of two well trained models on deep learning. The system uses adaptive thresholds and sophisticated preprocessing to ensure its performance stays high regardless of the conditions which include light, camera angle, and facial expressions. Such consistencies of both the methodologies in convergence help the system to assess the driver's alertness level and immediately produce an alert the moment the driver looks sleepy. Intended to be deployed in semi-autonomous vehicles, vehicles in commercial fleets, as well as individual automobiles, the proposed system can be implemented at a large-scale to help increase road safety. Thus, eliminating the risks related to fatigue-related accidents, it opens an opportunity to minimize fatality rates and change the future environment in transport. The technical issues, the difficulties and the realistic uses of the system are also described This paper focuses on the contribution of the system to enhance road safety and reduce the number of deaths.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: One of the most significant and difficult issues in medical image processing is brain tumor segmentation (BTS) as human classification might cause improper diagnosis and prognosis. Furthermore, when a lot of data needs to be contributed it is an annoying task. It becomes challenging to identify tumor regions in images as brain tumors (BT) exhibit a great level of visual variation as well as mimic healthy tissues. Using the fuzzy C-Means clustering (FCM) approach, we proposed in the current work to exclude brain cancers from the two dimensional MRI. Next came convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and traditional classifiers. Utilizing a real-time dataset which had a diversity of tumor locations, sizes, shapes, image intensities, this experimental study was carried out. Next, we discussed CNNs, which are built with Keras and Tensorflow since they outperform the conventional ones. In this investigation, CNN attained an amazing accuracy rate that is 87.87%. This study's primary objective is to make the differentiation between normal and aberrant pixels utilizing statistical along with texture-based criteria.

articleTitle: Towards Accurate Skin Cancer Screening: A CNN Model for Dermatological Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Early detection is vital for effective treatment and increased survival rates in the case of skin cancer, which is a common type of cancer globally. Machine learning (ML) has become a promising tool in the field of dermatology, providing improved precision and effectiveness in the screening of skin cancer. This assessment examines the different classification methods used in machine learning for detecting skin cancer, discussing the techniques, outcomes, and obstacles linked to these approaches. The research investigates widely utilized algorithms like CNNs, SVMs, and ensemble methods, analyzing how they are utilized in distinguishing between cancerous and non-cancerous growths. It also touches upon the significance of image preprocessing, feature extraction, and data augmentation in enhancing classification performance. In addition, the analysis discusses present constraints, such as a lack of data, prejudice, and the necessity for transparency in ML models, emphasizing topics for further study. This paper aims to lead future advancements in ML-based skin cancer screening by offering a comprehensive summary of the current state of the field, resulting in more precise, available, and scalable diagnostic options.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Web Security with Lightweight, Minimal Vulnerability Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Web vulnerability scanners have an important function of defining security vulnerabilities and possible penetrations in web applications. Old style scanners are usually more complicated with procedures and require many resources from a system which makes them rather inconvenient for developers and small businesses. This paper describes a new web vulnerability scanner that is designed to be extremely lightweight and easy to use while meeting the need for vulnerability detection. As a result of the application of minimalistic design and automation, the proposed scanner mainly targets fundamental features, including identification of well-known types of vulnerabilities, including SQL injections, cross-site scripting (XSS), and insecure headers. A modular design is used, and that means the scanner is built for flexibility and can adapt to different web environments. Performance evaluations show that this simplified approach has further accuracy and similar level of convergence as current methods while gaining considerable advantages in terms of setup time and computational burden. This work alleges to fill the gap between usability and security; giving users background information on how to incorporate effective vulnerability assessment into their developmental life cycle.

articleTitle: Navigating Interfaces: Gaze and Gesture as Multimodal Inputs
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The project Multimodal Maestro believes in a groundbreaking system of human-computer interaction (HCI) for the benefit of common users and people with disabilities. It provides two visual input methods which includes eye movement and hand gesture, the choice is made by the users based on their convenience and accessibility needs. For general users, Multimodal Maestro opens up a new realm of interaction allowing for a more intuitive and immersive connection with technology. To achieve this we have used the advanced embedded machine learning algorithms such as CNN, Douglas-Peucker, EAR(Eye Aspect Ratio)- based LDA(Landmark Detection Algorithm) and LSTM(Long Short Term Memory) which decodes gestures and very subtle eye movements, including blinks and shifts in gaze into commands including cursor movement, click, and screen element selection [3]–[28]. In tandem, hand gestures provide a natural and expressive alternative way to communicate with technology, thus enhancing the user experience, offering seamless handsfree control. For a person with disabilities, Multimodal Maestro is a game-changer, this will provide a very accessible tool for people with limited mobility to have a way to interact with technology without relying on any traditional input devices[10]. Gaze-based control gives a powerful and inclusive option for mobility-impaired users, while hand gestures provide an additional channel of communication with maximum freedom and independence offering flexibility and personalization, from these two complementary input methods, which is also a suite of adaptive, personalized, and accessible interface. For the first time, this system aims to make technology accessible to all users irrespective of their capabilities and preferences, directing a new challenging path where users can interact with computers in a way that is more natural, empowering and efficient.

articleTitle: Efficient Internet of Things Based Smart Dustbin Using GSM Module
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The main aim of this project is to develop a smart dustbin to maintain cleanliness in the environment. There are sensors in smart bins that can tell how full the bin is. Usually, this data is sent wirelessly via Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. This lets waste management teams find the best ways for collections and cut down on pick-ups that aren't needed. In this project the lid of the dustbin opens automatically by sensing an object in front of it. And also it can segregate waste into dry and wet waste additionally, it notifies the user through an SMS, when the dustbin becomes full. After all hardware and software connection, now smart dustbin will program and run. In this research work we can ensure environment cleanliness by which garbage are not thrown on the streets and also safe fuel of the garbage vehicle.

articleTitle: Leveraging Retinal Images for Detection and Classification of Diabetic Retinopathy Using DenseNet121 and ResNet50
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy, which affects up to 80% of patients with diabetes who have the disease for ten years or longer, is the result of diabetic damage to the retina. When it comes to places where diabetic retinopathy diagnosis is most critical, the necessary equipment and knowledge are sometimes inadequate. The majority of research on diabetic retinopathy has focused on manually extracting features or detecting the disease; however, A novel deep neural network based on DenseNet121 and ResNet50 architectures was introduced to predict the severity level of diabetic retinopathy in retinal image scans, with the aim of aiding in early-stage treatment interventions. In this research, deep convolutional neural networks with GPU acceleration are designed and put into practice for autonomously diagnosing and classifying high-resolution retinal pictures into five disease phases based on severity. Training accuracy in DenseNet121 achieved is 98.3% and ResNet50 is 98.47% and Validation Accuracy in DenseNet121 achieved is 96.8% and ResNet50 is 97.1 %. Resnet50 performs slightly better than DenseNet121.

articleTitle: LLM-Driven Peer Competitor and Stock Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The competitive landscape is a significant factor in strategic corporate decision-making, and therefore the identification of peer competitors is crucial for businesses, investors, and financial analysts. This paper introduces an automated system that utilizes Large Language Models (LLMs) and financial data retrieval methods to improve competitor identification for U.S. firms. By combining company descriptions from Wikipedia with financial information retrieved through APIs, the suggested system greatly enhances the effectiveness of market analysis and competitive intelligence. The system offers useful insights to corporations for strategic planning and investors for making smart decisions. Automation of competitor identification saves manual labor along with offering accurate and real-time data availability, thus making it a scalable solution specific to the U.S. financial market.

articleTitle: Modeling Adversarial Strategies in GPU Side-Channel Attacks: A Game-Theoretic Perspective
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The use of Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) in safety-critical applications is increasing; yet, their highly parallel designs provide weaknesses that facilitate side-channel attacks, enabling the theft of confidential information. Prior research has shown that time, contention, power, and access pattern side-channels are viable against GPU workloads. Nonetheless, their current protections remain insufficient to comprehensively safeguard real-world shader operations. A novel game-theoretical framework is proposed to model and evaluate the intricate dynamics between attackers and defenders in GPU side-channel assaults. The interactions are reformulated as a two-player, non-cooperative game, and the best tactics for both players have been established under various payment models and danger situations. Experimental results obtained from commercial GPUs corroborate that the suggested technique effectively represents hostile dynamics in reality, necessitating the development of resilient countermeasures. This project seeks to bridge the gap between theoretical security analysis and practical GPU protection methods. We provide a robust foundation for designing appropriate and secure GPU architectures for continuously changing side channel threadings. Human-centric approaches to driving work emphasise the need of considering human elements like as perception, judgement, and decision-making to effectively assess adversary techniques in cybersecurity. The game theoretical model offers a structured approach for forecasting probable assault vectors, assessing defence methods, and formulating effective counters customised to the adversary.

articleTitle: Developing a Translation Model to Bridge ASL and Indian Regional Languages Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: In this resarch work, a real-time hand gesture detection system for Ame rican Sign Language (ASL) that enables the deaf-dumb co mmun ity to interact with others by translating sign language into text. The current methods for translating ASL to English primarily use computer vision tools like Media Pipe and OpenPose to recognise hand landma rks and motions. To tackle this issue, we provide a novel convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture that removes the need for manual feature engineering by automatically obtaining discriminative spatial-temporal characteristics from raw video streams. CNNs are more suited to handle the dynamic and highly changeable nature of hand movements because they are very good in simu Itaneously recording spatial and temporal informat ion, unlike LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) networks, which are frequently emp loyed for sequential data. CNNs are perfect for rea l-t ime applications because they provide more efficient processing and faster inference time. By using multilingual language translators and advanced CNNbased deep learning models, we aim to reduce the communication gaps across India's diverse linguistic minorities. To ensure accurate performance evaluation and successful model learning, the dataset was divided into 70 % for tra inin <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$g$</tex> and 30 % for testing. Compared to tradit ional methods, the proposed approach has a 95% accuracy rate. With potential uses in public services, healthcare, and education, this program encourages assistive technology by offering a practical tool to improve communicat ion between sign language users and the general public. Through encouraging interlanguage contact, the system helps create a society that is more inclusive.

articleTitle: Efficient Parking Spot Allocation in a Grid-Based Parking Lot
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Parking management in urban areas faces significant challenges, including congestion, inefficient allocation, and unauthorized use of parking spaces. Building on a previous study that proposes a dynamic parking management system using a grid-based structure that categorizes parking spots as long-term or short-term, allowing for flexible and efficient allocation, this study focuses on optimizing and extending the system for greater efficiency. The system incorporates and compares four algorithms—Dijkstra's, Bellman-Ford, Content-Based Search (CBS), and Jump Point Search (JPS)—along with a novel Combined Search Algorithm, designed to optimize parking allocation and exit determination. The proposed Combined Search Algorithm demonstrated superior efficiency through comprehensive evaluation, reducing allocation and exit determination times by approximately 18% compared to Dijkstra's, 25% to Bellman- Ford, 20% to CBS, and 15% to JPS. These results highlight the approach's potential to significantly improve parking management by optimizing resource utilization, minimizing conflicts, and enhancing user experience.

articleTitle: Automated Prediction of Breast Cancer: Performance Comparison Between Classical ML Algorithms and CNN
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Breast cancer is a condition in which aberrant breast cells grow uncontrollably, forming tumors that are extremely fatal if left unattended or undiagnosed. It is currently extremely prevalent globally. In 2022, women in 257 countries out of 185 were affected by breast cancer as the prevailing cancer type. It has existed from historic times, and can be traced back to the Egyptians, around 1500 B.C. In terms of deaths due to cancer, breast cancer stands as the principal driver. It caused 670,000 deaths globally in 2022, among the 2.3 million diagnosed women [1]. This necessitates accurate and timely detection for improved treatment outcomes and reduced mortality rates. This paper evaluates traditional machine learning frameworks (RF, Logistic Regression, SVM, KNN) and CNNs for detection of breast cancer using the Wisconsin Diagnostic dataset. Models are compared using accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and confusion matrix. Findings demonstrate that results obtained from the CNN are excellent and can be compared with the Logistic Regression and SVM model in terms of overall outcome. The results obtained using Logistic Regression and SVM are equivalent. Thus, this paper highlights the importance of utilizing machine learning for better diagnostic consistency.

articleTitle: Forecasting Cryptocurrency Prices in the DeFi Ecosystem Using Predictive Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving cryptocurrency markets, accurate price prediction is crucial for investors and traders. This task investigates the efficacy of advanced machine learning and deep learning for forecasting cryptocurrency prices. The proposed idea utilizes Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) models, Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi- LSTM) networks, Gated Recurrent Units (GRU), and Long Short-Term Memory networks improved with Self-Attention (LSTM-Self-Attention). Numerous studies were conducted using the historical data available. Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) were used to evaluate the models. The study tries to show the impact of outside factors such as economic data and market belief in purchase to improve the precision of the forecast. This research offers investors and policy makers insight that demonstrates the ability of sophisticated machine learning models to navigate the intricacies of cryptocurrency marketplaces. Incorporating these approaches into a single predictive framework enables accurate forecasting and the identification of anomalies in DeFi markets. The findings contribute to the decision making that is strategic DeFi investments, providing tools for better prediction and analysis, and laying the groundwork for future advancements in DeFi analytics.

articleTitle: Integrating NLP for Intelligent Cybersecurity Risk Detection from Bulletins
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The rate of developed threats increases and poses challenges when it comes to the recognition of the risks and measures to be taken. Current cybersecurity risk assessment is mainly done using word-of-mouth through reviewed security announcements, vulnerable product or service reports, and threat intelligence data feeds, all of which are time-consuming and often contain human errors. The use of Natural Language Processing (NLP) in cybersecurity brings the efficiency of automation where text information is analyzed with the aim of identifying and categorizing threats in real time. In this paper, NLP techniques including Named Entity Recognition (NER), sentiment analysis and topic modelling are used to analyze the security bulletins and determine the security threats. Supervised, semi-supervised, and unsupervised learning methods of the NLP system can bene fit to mine adequate security-related text data, identify suitable patterns and or make forecasts of susceptible vulnerabilities. The proposed framework is primarily a framework to improve threat intelligence through vulnerability, attack vectors, and related systems connection. In addition, NLP-based risk identification also has several advantages: it increases the accuracy of risk identification and decreases the time for risk detection, as well as strengthens cybersecurity infrastructure. The paper demonstrates that by applying the technique of IBM security bulletins, organizations can reduce the risks and improve the controls effectively. The paper concludes with areas of future work in enhancing the application of NLP techniques in cybersecurity with an agreement on the idea of adaptive models that reflects the dynamic and ever-changing nature and trends of cyber threats.

articleTitle: Deep Learning - Based Prediction Models for Colon and Rectum Cancer Disease: Enhancing the Precision Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Colon and rectal cancer are among the leading causes of cancer-related illness and death worldwide. The detection and treatment of colon cancer are viewed as social and economic issues due to the high fatality rates. Every year, around half a million people worldwide develop cancer, including colon cancer. Although improving patient outcomes requires an accurate and timely diagnosis, traditional diagnostic methods usually suffer from subjectivity and variability problems. An extensive summary of colon cancer diagnosis is given here. Deep learning, a branch of artificial intelligence, has become a powerful tool for increasing cancer detection accuracy by utilizing large datasets and complex algorithms. This study combines genomic data, medical imaging, histopathological analysis, and clinical decision-making tools to better comprehend the creation and application of deep learning-based prediction models in the diagnosis of colon and rectal cancer. Through the use of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and hybrid models, deep learning can improve the accuracy of cancer detection, anticipate the course of a disease, and assist with customized treatment planning. By automating and enhancing diagnostic precision, these models have the potential to revolutionize healthcare workflows, reduce diagnostic errors, and ultimately increase patient survival rates. This research also discusses the challenges and possible advantages of using deep learning to clinical practice for colon and rectal cancer. Last but not least, the problems that exist today and possible directions for future research are examined.

articleTitle: Dynamic Content Generation for Learning Management System Using Generative AI
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The following paper presents the newly developed concept of Artificial Intelligence-based LMS that intends to revolutionize contemporary education and enhance the flow of education. The system also has built-in tools that help the user to filter courses on different aspects of goal - orientation, for specific coding exams or for professional development, as well as for users with particular levels of difficulty. Such features as quizzes, flashcards, chapter wise course with added YouTube videos, chatbot integrated in the Q&A module. The system empowers users to tailor their courses based on specific goals, such as preparing for job coding exams or professional skill development, while also adjusting for individual difficulty levels. Core features include interactive quizzes, flashcards, chapter-wise course enriched with YouTube videos, chatbot feature, question and-answer module. Another component to increase interaction is testing module which allows users to practice their knowledge and check the result by passing the questions and answers. Additionally, it offers two standout capabilities powered by Gemini AI: a math aid, which involves a virtual teacher that offers solutions to uploaded mathematics questions and a guide that helps users go through information on the Internet using conversion. The most remarkable one is the mock interview module, which along with analysing user responses to the questions presented by AI. Thus, it links the educational process with the opportunities for career growth, providing its users with the resources to address actual difficulties. Based on modern technologies, the LMS utilizes the Neon database for data management, Inngest for the event-based execution of actions, Clerk for authentication, and a fast frontend based on Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS. The following paper aims to discuss the system, its application and the ways in which it is poised to revolutionise learning in the era of the web.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Comparison of MobileNet, ResNet50 and InceptionV3 for Efficient Plant Pathology Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Plant diseases have a strong impact on agricultural productivity due to economic factors and a reduction in crop quality. This work focuses on the classification of apple leaves into four classes: healthy, rust-infected, scab-infected, and infected by both diseases, using the Plant Pathology FGVC7-2020 dataset that contains 3,642 images in total. The work involves the analysis of three sophisticated deep learning architectures: ResNet50, MobileNet and InceptionV3.It turned out that MobileN et showed the highest performance, reaching a 92% accuracy rate; it was followed by ResNet50 with 75% accuracy and InceptionV3 at 73%, hence underlining its better generalization capability and efficiency in classifying. We discuss the proposed methodology, which includes data preprocessing techniques, experimental results and final conclusions, is discussed in detail. These results underline the fundamental importance of determining an appropriate neural network architecture for the recognition of plant diseases, which is of prime importance to improve agricultural productivity.

articleTitle: Pothole Detection: Machine Learning and Computer Vision Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Potholes have become a major threat to road safety in recent times, accidents and fatalities have been associated with them in large numbers, especially when drivers are unable to notice the potholes and avoid them in due time. Hence, Pothole detection and mitigation are critical aspects of maintaining road infrastructure and ensuring commuter safety. Traditional methods of identification of potholes using manual inspections are both time-consuming and labour-intensive. So, in the recent years many machine learning models and algorithms like You Only Look Once (YOLO), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), etc have emerged to accurately detect and help mitigate potholes. In this paper, a comparative analysis of these methodologies is presented based on accuracy, real-time performance and cost-efficiency.

articleTitle: Techniques for Influencer Detection, Mapping, and Popularity Prediction in Social Media Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: This paper recognizes the fact that in an age where consumption patterns are closely linked with social media platforms the measurement of key influential personalities and their effects on consumers is crucial. This paper offers an extensive analysis of the state-of-the-art methods for influencer identification and influence mapping. Approaches used in this research are based on Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms which include Graph Attention Networks, Gated Recurrent Units, Graph-based Long Short-Term Memory Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks, Stacked Autoencoders, Centrality Measures, and Frameworks such as Stimulus Organism Response. Comparing all of these approaches reveals their role in improving influencer marketing approaches, targeting, and the level of engagement, and profitability. The current study will benefit this area of knowledge by showing the outcomes, performance, and computational strengths of these approaches, paving the way for the enhancement of influencer marketing technology.

articleTitle: JivaCare: A Smart Health Care Application Integrating Home Remedies for Holistic Well-Being
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: JivaCare is a smart health care application that aims to diagnose common illnesses and recommend home remedies by leveraging advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML). Initially, a custom dataset of diseases and symptoms was used to develop a disease-diagnoses chatbot. However, challenges such as limited accuracy and rigid disease-symptom mapping were identified. To address these, GPT-3.5 API was integrated via RapidAPI, enhancing conversational quality without requiring extensive training while improving response quality. A MySQL database was implemented to store conversational history and session-based memory. Subsequently, the focus transitioned to a text classification approach using a 5,634-sample dataset from HuggingFace. This enabled flexible symptom-to-disease classification, overcoming the limitations of the initial dataset. Five machine learning models were evaluated, with Logistic Regression achieving the highest accuracie of 85 % after fine-tuning its hyperparameters. Additionally, neural network architectures such as GRU, RNN and CNN were also employed, achieving validation accuracies of 76%, 82% and 84%, respectively. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of integrating ML and deep learning techniques for accurate disease prediction and remedy recommendation. This work can establish the foundation for a scalable and user-friendly healthcare system, bridging the gap between AI and personalised natural health benefits.

articleTitle: Enhanced Instagram Spam Detection Using Convolutional Attention Networks with Water Wave Optimization-Based Fine-Tuning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Worldwide economies are vulnerable to financial fraud, which costs people and companies billions of dollars yearly. Conventional ways of detecting fraud are inadequate in this age of increasingly digital transactions. In this paper, we take most recent developments in the field of real-time financial fraud detection, including methods that use behavioral analytics, blockchain, AI, and ML. With the help of several case studies and practical applications, we also offer data-driven insights regarding detection rates, cost efficiency, and industry-specific obstacles. Instagram comment sections have a long history of spam and fraudulent posts, and the financial sector is no exception. New victims are being added daily. The present spam filter on Instagram isn't good enough, and most of the research that has been done so far has focused on theoretical ideas. There is a lack of practical implementations that have been reviewed. Questions of data quality, scalability, interpretability of models, and real- time processing are some of the obstacles to using machine learning for fraud detection. Additionally, we cover the ethical and privacy issues that come up when dealing with financial transactions that involve machine learning. The paper's goal is to help build trust in financial institutions and create more effective and ethical fraud detection systems using machine learning by drawing attention to these elements. To improve the accuracy of spam classification, we provide a Convolutional Attention-Based Mechanism (CBA) in conjunction with Water Wave Optimization (WWO). Deep feature representations are extracted by the convolutional layers, with the assistance of the attention mechanism, which helps to concentrate on noteworthy patterns. In order to maximize performance, the WWO algorithm adjusts the hyperparameters. In comparison to traditional deep learning models, our experimental results show that our model achieves better classification accuracy, recall, precision, and F1-score. High efficiency and resilience in identifying spam accounts are achieved by this strategy

articleTitle: HealthGuard: A Blockchain-Based Framework for Secure EHR Management
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Traditional Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems experience centralized vulnerabilities which explain how healthcare data breaches reach about 45% of cases. Operability requirements reveal patient data to multiple entities which creates breakable data structures that compromise security. Blockchain technology gives patients an alternative system that operates with decentralized security while maintaining transparency. HealthGuard exists to provide medical patients complete control over their healthcare records with built-in privacy features and educational decision solutions. The authentication security comes from Ethereum combined with Metamask services while decentralized storage solutions create revolutionary methods to protect sensitive information. The system operates more efficiently because smart contracts simplify connections between patients and their healthcare providers including lab technicians. Healthcare facilities can achieve advanced data protection through blockchain storage which improves patient care interconnectivity with individualized care plans. The combination of smart contracts together with decentralized applications helps reduce healthcare administration costs which leads to efficiency growth. Through blockchain technology the healthcare system develops better security and changes toward patient-centered care which enables people to manage their health information actively.

articleTitle: A Study on Next-Generation Malware Reverse Engineering Paradigms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: As cyber threats evolve, complex malware targets various systems, weak points in a wide range of situations and can't be stopped by conventional measures. To address these emerging and potent threats, this paper examines the next-generation malware reverse engineering paradigms. We discuss how AI/ML is applicable to the topic for anomaly detection, hypervisor-based introspection to secure continuous monitoring, memory analysis for file-less malware, and system calls mapping that helps in tracking the execution flow of malware. Measures, which allow countering modern malware's features such as obfuscation, polymorphism, and encrypted messages, are described, and they include methods like a hybrid approach to threat analysis, adaptable sandboxes, and heuristic modeling. Some of these techniques have been showcased herein with real-life examples captured in the enterprise and industrial control systems domains. Prevention techniques including the use of prediction models and automatic response mechanisms to control threats are presented to improve threat detection and mitigation. Lastly, in the area of future perspectives for malware detection and analysis, the research looks at quantum-resistant security features, the adoption of blockchain technologies for safe threat sharing as well as progress in cognitive computing for supporting decision-making processes. Such emerging paradigms are emblematic of the need for constant change to preserve a high-security level as the threats keep growing much more severe in the present day context.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Alzheimer's Detection: A Novel Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a gradually increasing neu- rodegenerative disorder, it presents its manifestations with cognitive decline and brain degeneration, above all in aged individuals. Such early diagnosis is paramount precisely because of the irreversibility of its progression, an urgent clinical, social, and economic need. This study puts forward deep learning methods or approaches in the scenario of MRI data in detecting and classifying AD at different stages, such as Non-Demented, Mildly Demented, Moderately Demented, and Severely Demented. The results were exceptional with the CNNs, autoencoders, and transfer learning reporting up to 99.68% classification accuracy by the models. Based on these, this paper introduces a new hybrid framework that incorporates the stacked sparse autoencoders which is used for deep feature extraction and transfer learning with Inception-V4 CNNs. The proposed approach encompasses MRI preprocessing using elastic deformations, sensitivity ana lysis of brain Regions of Interest, and ensemble classification techniques that ensure high accuracy with less complexity and improved interpretability. This framework brings early-stage AD detection to a new level, addresses the current challenges, and hopefully promises better clinical, social, and economic outcomes.

articleTitle: Hybrid LSTM-GA and HS-CS Algorithms for Automation-Assisted Defect Identification in CNC Milling Robotics: Enhancing Global Search and Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: This paper introduces a hybrid algorithmic framework that merges Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, Genetic Algorithms (GA), Harmony Search (HS), and Cuckoo Search (CS) for detecting flaws in Computer Numerical Control (CNC) milling automatically. LSTM networks are used for processing time-series data, while GA optimizes hyperparameters to enhance accuracy. Efficient feature extraction and overall optimization search benefit from the use of HS and CS. The hybrid approach addresses challenges in real-time defect detection by surpassing individual models in metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and mean squared error (MSE). In CNC milling, this minimizes interruptions and enhances production excellence. The study aims to optimize real-time flaw detection in CNC milling by utilizing a combination of LSTM-GA and HS-CS algorithms. The project's goal is to achieve accurate and efficient defect classification by utilizing HS-CS for global search and feature selection, with minimal human involvement and production delay. The goal is to demonstrate how hybrid algorithms improve defect detection efficiency and reduce error rates, leading to precise and automated CNC milling solutions. HS and CS are used to select features and perform a global search, while LSTM is integrated into the model to analyze time-series data, and GA is employed to optimize hyperparameters. Accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and MSE are metrics utilized for evaluating performance. The hybrid LSTM-GA and HS-CS model outperformed individual approaches with 97.5% accuracy, 96.3% precision, 94.5% recall, and an F1 score of 0.954, which is equal to its MSE. This combination method is suitable for real-time industrial automation tasks as it enhances fault detection in CNC milling, reducing errors and enhancing precision.

articleTitle: Implementing the Potential of Automatic Detection of Power Quality Disruption using Deep Learning Techniques and its Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: A variety of energy sources are being included in the existing power grid to meet the increasing electricity demand. However, this increases the possibility of Power Quality (PQ)deterioration during processes like production, and trans- mission. There has been a significant uptick in research efforts devoted to PQ in recent years. Harmonics in energy and spikes or drops in voltage must be investigated to ensure PQ. All these abnormalities are referred to as power quality disturbances (PQD). To reduce the danger, it is necessary to detect and classify the PQD. The standard method separates this task into several distinct phases, including signal processing, feature extraction, selection, and feature-based categorization. Unfortunately, there are flaws in the signal processing approach, and selecting features manually is time-consuming and inaccurate. For this reason, conventional models are less effective at classifying PQD and are more susceptible to noise. In this research, we present the Deep Learning (DL) framework as an alternative to the existing approaches. A wide variety of signal data with various PQDs are produced using MATLAB. Using DL models such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Autoencoder (AE), and a hybrid of Long Short-Term Memory with Autoencoder, the PQD are autonomously recognized and classified by the type. Finally, the comparative findings of all three DL models are presented. With an accuracy of 95.3%, the proposed hybrid model (LSTM- Autoencoder) is discovered to be an effective PQD classifier. Keywords— x

articleTitle: Implementing Machine Learning for Early Detection and Prognostic Modeling of Chronic Diseases
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: The employ of deep learning methods for the diagnosis and prognosis model of chronic diseases is an important discovery to change the healthcare service. Some of the chronic diseases which prevalence and incidence rates remain high globally include diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, chronic kidney diseases, and cancers. There is nothing more critical than early diagnosis and accurate prediction of the patients' condition and the best course of action that has to be taken. This paper aims at examining the possibility of utilizing ANN, Random Forest, XGBoost, and CNN to forecast the occurrence of the. Due to integration of big and varied data which involve clinical characteristics, biochemical parameters and medical images among others, ML models have the ability recognize complex relations not easily recognizable by conventional diagnostic procedures. These illustrations prove that deep learning models or more specifically the convolutional neural networks for image diagnosis outperform other traditional methods in performance and prognosis. Nevertheless, some issues, such as data quality, model's interpretability, and its implementation into clinical practice, are still present. The challenges appeared in this paper are key to understanding the future of ML in healthcare as they can pave the way to the integration of such models into practice, therefore leading to early detection, better prognosis, and effective management of chronic diseases. This paper aims at exploring on how ML can be of significance in transformation of the health care sector and orderly improve patients care.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning Model for Prostate Cancer Detection Using LeNet and MobileNet V2 Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Cancer of the prostate is among the most common neoplasms worldwide and in men especially; therefore, early diagnosis enhances the chances of the patients. In this work, we propose a proposed deep-learning framework by integrating LeNet and MobileNet V2 architectures for early diagnosis of prostate cancer from medical images. The proposed model had an accuracy of 96.2% and precision of 97.9<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, a recall of 96.9% and F1-Score of 97.4% and surpassed LeNet, MobileNet V2 and ResNet-50 and DenseNet-121 models. The particularity of the test was confirmed with a confusion matrix that revealed 15 false negatives and 10 false positives. From the computational perspective, the model has an inference time of roughly 48 ms for per image and has a memory consumption of 60 MB, it is thus fast for real time applications in clinics. It adds more explainability techniques such as Grad-CAM, which improves interpretability, which is essential for clinician trust. This work shows that PFCLA can be used in early diagnosis of prostate cancer using enhanced deep learning hybrid model and future works that can be done include, Exploratory Study of More real world independent data set on PFCLA along with, Expanding the applicability of PFCLA to other medical imaging tasks.

articleTitle: Astronomical Image Clustering Using Spectral, K-Means and Mean Shift
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: By analyzing vast amounts of observational data through astronomical image analysis, you can gain valuable information about the structure of the universe. This paper presents a new method for clustering astronomical images that uses both spectral and K-means methods and also incorporates linear algebra and optimization principles. We propose a method that combines feature extraction techniques such as the Fourier transform with clustering algorithms to classify celestial objects based on their characteristics. The research examines the effectiveness of spectral clustering and K-means clustering in organizing astronomical images into meaningful groups, taking into account factors such as computer efficiency, clustering accuracy and interpretability. Experimenting with different datasets, including telescope images, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in automating the classification of astronomical objects. Our results reveal insights into the underlying structure of astronomical knowledge and offer promising avenues for future research in computational astronomy. In general, this research advances both the field of astronomy and the application of mathematical methods to image analysis and clustering.

articleTitle: Improving Face Recognition for Smart Home Security: A Study of Resnet, Siamese Networks, and Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: This study presents a smart doorbell system designed to improve home security through advanced deep learning techniques. At its core, the system utilizes the YOLOv5 (You Only Look Once) algorithm for real-time face detection, ensuring accurate and efficient visitor identification. To further strengthen security, the system employs multifactor authentication (MFA), integrating face recognition alongside speech recognition and or/a manual keypad. The study evaluates three neural network architectures for face recognition-ResNet with cosine similarity, a Siamese network with CNN, and an attention-enhanced Siamese network-to determine the most effective model for secure and reliable authentication. Performance comparisons highlight progressive improvements in accuracy and robustness,. Additionally, a convenient interface enables seamless remote monitoring and control, enhancing both security and convenience. By addressing key limitations of existing smart security systems, this research provides insight into improving intelligent home access control.

articleTitle: From Sky to Spectrum: Unveiling the Potential of 6G for UAV Communication
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are becoming indispensable tools across civil, environmental, and military operations. This paper provides an overview of the classification of UAVs and their roles in enhancing operational efficiency and connectivity, particularly through the integration of 6G technology. It highlights the Distributed Edge-based Collaborative Knowledge- Sharing (DECKS) Architecture, which focuses on local data processing and the integration of AI for UAV traffic management. The discussion encompasses energy efficiency strategies, such as trajectory optimization and energy harvesting, as well as solutions for addressing security vulnerabilities, including blockchain technology. Furthermore, innovative communication methods, such as Device-to-Device (D2D) communication and Free Space Optical (FSO) wireless communication technologies, are explored. This study underscores the transformative potential of UAVs in shaping the future of connectivity and emphasizes the necessity for continued innovation in this field.

articleTitle: Enhanced Realtime Sign Language Detection and Multilingual Translation System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Sign language is the communication medium that is utilized by the hearing-impaired community. The medium is visual and it uses hand signs and symbols for communication. Over 300 different types of sign languages present in the world today. Sign language uses gestures and hand movements for the majority of the words and finger spellings for the rest. Nonverbal speakers face a lot of challenges while interacting with verbal speakers. Even non-verbal speakers who speak different sign languages face difficulties communicating with each other. This project proposes an enhanced real-time system which detects gestures and finger spellings of multiple sign languages, and translates them into multiple spoken languages. The proposed system aims to utilize CNN network for finger spelling recognition and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network for gesture interpretation. The system will use computer vision for accurate gesture detection and Google Translator API for recognizing signs which will be translated into multiple spoken languages. Initial tests with isolated datasets indicate promising accuracy for both finger spelling and gesture recognition. The goal of the completed system is to help aid communication between verbal and non-verbal speakers and to provide an efficient mode of communication between the two communities.

articleTitle: Detection of Malicious Interpreted Code using ML to Optimize Parameters for Minimizing Prediction Errors
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Mobile devices face growing cybersecurity threats, including malware, data breaches, malicious applications, and social engineering attacks. Cybercriminals exploit these vulnerabilities to gain unauthorized access, disrupt communication, and compromise sensitive information. Conventional malware detection methods, such as signature-based and heuristic techniques, often struggle to identify evolving threats due to their reliance on predefined patterns. This study presents an advanced malware detection framework that integrates a Reservoir Network with a Deep Learning Approach (DLA) to enhance detection accuracy and minimize prediction errors. The proposed method utilizes two static features-API call permissions and alert signals- to improve detection efficiency. Experimental evaluation, conducted using the Drebin malware dataset, demonstrates that the proposed model achieves an accuracy of 99.7 %, reduces the false positive rate to below 1 %, and ensures optimal processing speed with a batch size of 64 and a learning rate of 0.001. Compared to traditional approaches, this framework exhibits superior adaptability to obfuscated malware while enabling real-time threat detection. The findings emphasize the effectiveness of machine learning (ML)-driven security mechanisms in addressing emerging cybersecurity threats.

articleTitle: ViTYoga: Vision Transformer for Real-Time Yoga Pose Estimation and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)
abstract: Recognizing and analyzing yoga poses is a critical aspect of yoga practices and is vital when it is supported by technology. The importance of yoga arises from its ability to promote mental and physical well-being, stress reduction, im-proved focus, emotional stability, resilience, spiritual growth, and a life-centered perspective. As the popularity of yoga continues to grow, technological advancements are becoming increasingly vital to assist yoga instructors and practitioners in monitoring and enhancing their practice. This work elucidates the significance of automated yoga pose detection and its potential benefits for enhancing self-correction, providing real-time feedback, and maximizing yoga benefits. The proposed work utilizes Vision Transformers (ViT) for real-time detection and monitoring of yoga poses, referred to as ViTYoga.
